WITH toy_daily AS (
  SELECT 
    date(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS d,
    SUM(oi.price) AS daily_sales,
    CAST(julianday(date(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS REAL) AS x
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
  WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
    AND date(o.order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-29'
    AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
  GROUP BY date(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    SUM(x) AS sx,
    SUM(daily_sales) AS sy,
    SUM(x*daily_sales) AS sxy,
    SUM(x*x) AS sxx
  FROM toy_daily
),
model AS (
  SELECT 
    (n*sxy - sx*sy)*1.0/(n*sxx - sx*sx) AS slope,
    (sy - ((n*sxy - sx*sy)*1.0/(n*sxx - sx*sx))*sx)/n AS intercept
  FROM stats
),
pred_days AS (
  SELECT 
    d,
    CAST(julianday(d) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS REAL) AS x
  FROM (
    SELECT '2018-12-01' AS d UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-02' UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-03' UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-04' UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-05' UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-06' UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-07' UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-08' UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-09' UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-10' UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-11' UNION ALL
    SELECT '2018-12-12'
  )
),
preds AS (
  SELECT pd.d, (m.slope * pd.x + m.intercept) AS pred
  FROM pred_days pd CROSS JOIN model m
),
moving AS (
  SELECT 
    d,
    (SELECT AVG(p2.pred) FROM preds p2 
     WHERE julianday(p2.d) BETWEEN julianday(p1.d)-2 AND julianday(p1.d)+2) AS ma5
  FROM preds p1
  WHERE d BETWEEN '2018-12-05' AND '2018-12-08'
)
SELECT SUM(ma5) FROM moving;

WITH daily_sales AS (
  SELECT
    date(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS d,
    SUM(oi.price) AS sales
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN product_category_name_translation t
    ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
  WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
    AND date(o.order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-29'
  GROUP BY date(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
calendar AS (
  SELECT date('2017-01-01', '+' || n || ' days') AS d
  FROM (
    WITH RECURSIVE seq(n) AS (
      SELECT 0
      UNION ALL
      SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 1000
    )
    SELECT n FROM seq
  )
  WHERE date('2017-01-01', '+' || n || ' days') <= '2018-08-29'
),
filled AS (
  SELECT c.d, COALESCE(ds.sales, 0) AS sales
  FROM calendar c
  LEFT JOIN daily_sales ds ON ds.d = c.d
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT d, sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d) AS rn
  FROM filled
),
regression AS (
  SELECT
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(rn * sales) - SUM(rn) * SUM(sales)) * 1.0 /
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(rn * rn) - SUM(rn) * SUM(rn)) AS slope,
    (SUM(sales) - ((COUNT(*) * SUM(rn * sales) - SUM(rn) * SUM(sales)) * 1.0 /
      (COUNT(*) * SUM(rn * rn) - SUM(rn) * SUM(rn))) * SUM(rn)) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS intercept,
    COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM numbered
),
future_days AS (
  SELECT date('2018-08-30', '+' || n || ' days') AS d
  FROM (
    WITH RECURSIVE seq(n) AS (
      SELECT 0
      UNION ALL
      SELECT n + 1 FROM seq WHERE n < 200
    )
    SELECT n FROM seq
  )
  WHERE date('2018-08-30', '+' || n || ' days') <= '2018-12-12'
),
predicted AS (
  SELECT
    f.d,
    r.intercept + r.slope * (r.n + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.d)) AS pred_sales
  FROM future_days f
  CROSS JOIN regression r
),
moving_avg AS (
  SELECT
    d,
    AVG(pred_sales) OVER (
      ORDER BY d
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
    ) AS ma5
  FROM predicted
)
SELECT SUM(ma5)
FROM moving_avg
WHERE d BETWEEN '2018-12-05' AND '2018-12-08';

WITH daily_sales AS (
  SELECT date(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS d,
         SUM(oi.price) AS sales
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
  WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
    AND date(o.order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-29'
  GROUP BY date(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
all_days AS (
  SELECT date('2017-01-01', '+' || n || ' days') AS d
  FROM (
    WITH RECURSIVE cnt(n) AS (
      SELECT 0
      UNION ALL
      SELECT n+1 FROM cnt WHERE n < 1000
    )
    SELECT n FROM cnt
  )
  WHERE date('2017-01-01', '+' || n || ' days') <= '2018-08-29'
),
series AS (
  SELECT ad.d,
         COALESCE(ds.sales, 0) AS y,
         CAST(julianday(ad.d) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS INTEGER) AS x
  FROM all_days ad
  LEFT JOIN daily_sales ds ON ds.d = ad.d
),
reg AS (
  SELECT
    (COUNT(*) * SUM(x*y) - SUM(x)*SUM(y)) * 1.0 / (COUNT(*)*SUM(x*x) - SUM(x)*SUM(x)) AS slope,
    (SUM(y) - ((COUNT(*) * SUM(x*y) - SUM(x)*SUM(y)) * 1.0 / (COUNT(*)*SUM(x*x) - SUM(x)*SUM(x))) * SUM(x)) / COUNT(*) AS intercept
  FROM series
),
pred_days AS (
  SELECT date('2018-12-05', '+' || n || ' days') AS d,
         CAST(julianday(date('2018-12-05', '+' || n || ' days')) - julianday('2017-01-01') AS INTEGER) AS x
  FROM (
    WITH RECURSIVE c(n) AS (
      SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM c WHERE n < 3
    )
    SELECT n FROM c
  )
),
preds AS (
  SELECT pd.d, pd.x, (r.intercept + r.slope * pd.x) AS yhat
  FROM pred_days pd CROSS JOIN reg r
),
ma AS (
  SELECT pd.d,
         (SELECT AVG(p2.yhat)
          FROM preds p2
          WHERE p2.x BETWEEN pd.x - 2 AND pd.x + 2) AS ma5
  FROM preds pd
)
SELECT SUM(ma5) AS total_sum
FROM ma;

WITH spans AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    ABS(CAST(strftime('%Y', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', debut) AS INTEGER))
    + ABS(CAST(strftime('%m', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%m', debut) AS INTEGER)) / 12.0
    + ABS(CAST(strftime('%d', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%d', debut) AS INTEGER)) / 365.0 AS span
  FROM player
  WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND final_game IS NOT NULL AND debut <> '' AND final_game <> ''
)

WITH city_coords AS (
    SELECT
        ad.airport_code,
        json_extract(ad.city, '$.en') AS city_name,
        CAST(substr(ad.coordinates, 1, instr(ad.coordinates, ',') - 1) AS REAL) AS lon,
        CAST(substr(ad.coordinates, instr(ad.coordinates, ',') + 1, length(ad.coordinates) - instr(ad.coordinates, ',') - 1) AS REAL) AS lat
    FROM airports_data ad
),
route_distances AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN c1.city_name < c2.city_name THEN c1.city_name ELSE c2.city_name END AS city1,
        CASE WHEN c1.city_name < c2.city_name THEN c2.city_name ELSE c1.city_name END AS city2,
        2 * 6371 * asin(sqrt(
            sin(radians(c2.lat - c1.lat) / 2) * sin(radians(c2.lat - c1.lat) / 2) +
            cos(radians(c1.lat)) * cos(radians(c2.lat)) *
            sin(radians(c2.lon - c1.lon) / 2) * sin(radians(c2.lon - c1.lon) / 2)
        )) AS distance
    FROM flights f
    JOIN city_coords c1 ON f.departure_airport = c1.airport_code
    JOIN city_coords c2 ON f.arrival_airport = c2.airport_code
    WHERE c1.city_name <> c2.city_name
),
pair_avg AS (
    SELECT city1, city2, AVG(distance) AS avg_distance
    FROM route_distances
    GROUP BY city1, city2
),
bucketed AS (
    SELECT
        city1,
        city2,
        CASE
            WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0-1000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000-2000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000-3000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000-4000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000-5000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000-6000'
            ELSE '6000+'
        END AS distance_range
    FROM pair_avg
),
range_counts AS (
    SELECT distance_range, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bucketed
    GROUP BY distance_range
)
SELECT cnt
FROM range_counts
ORDER BY cnt ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 = 'A' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 = 'A' THEN 'helmet_used'
    WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 = 'B' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 = 'B' THEN 'helmet_not_used'
  END AS helmet_group,
  SUM(c.motorcyclist_killed_count) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id) AS fatality_rate_percent
FROM collisions c
JOIN parties p ON c.case_id = p.case_id
WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
  AND (
    p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('A','B')
    OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('A','B')
  )
GROUP BY helmet_group;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 = 'A' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 = 'A' THEN 'Helmet Worn'
    WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 = 'B' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 = 'B' THEN 'No Helmet'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS helmet_usage,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id) AS total_collisions,
  SUM(c.motorcyclist_killed_count) AS total_fatalities,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(c.motorcyclist_killed_count) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id), 2) AS fatality_rate_percentage
FROM collisions c
JOIN parties p ON c.case_id = p.case_id
WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
  AND (p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('A','B') OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('A','B'))
GROUP BY helmet_usage;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 = 'A' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 = 'A' THEN c.motorcyclist_killed_count ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 = 'A' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
    2
  ) AS helmet_fatality_rate,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 = 'B' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 = 'B' THEN c.motorcyclist_killed_count ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 = 'B' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0),
    2
  ) AS no_helmet_fatality_rate
FROM collisions c
JOIN parties p ON c.case_id = p.case_id
WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
  AND (
    p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('A','B')
    OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('A','B')
  );

WITH y2021 AS (
  SELECT primary_collision_factor AS cat, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM collisions
  WHERE substr(collision_date, 1, 4) = '2021'
  GROUP BY primary_collision_factor
),
tot2021 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM y2021),
top2021 AS (
  SELECT cat, cnt FROM y2021 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1
),
y2011 AS (
  SELECT primary_collision_factor AS cat, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM collisions
  WHERE substr(collision_date, 1, 4) = '2011'
  GROUP BY primary_collision_factor
),
tot2011 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM y2011)
SELECT
  (SELECT 100.0 * cnt / (SELECT total FROM tot2021) FROM top2021)
  -
  (SELECT 100.0 * COALESCE((SELECT cnt FROM y2011 WHERE cat = (SELECT cat FROM top2021)), 0) / (SELECT total FROM tot2011)) AS decrease_percentage_points;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    (MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2011 THEN pct END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN pct END)),
    2
  ) AS decrease_percentage_points
FROM (
  SELECT
    year,
    pcf_violation_category,
    100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY year) AS pct
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(strftime('%Y', collision_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
      pcf_violation_category
    FROM collisions
    WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', collision_date) AS INTEGER) IN (2011, 2021)
      AND pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL
  )
  GROUP BY year, pcf_violation_category
)
WHERE pcf_violation_category = (
  SELECT pcf_violation_category
  FROM (
    SELECT
      pcf_violation_category,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM collisions
    WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', collision_date) AS INTEGER) = 2021
      AND pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY pcf_violation_category
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
);

WITH y21 AS (
  SELECT pcf_violation_category AS cat, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM collisions
  WHERE substr(collision_date,1,4)='2021'
  GROUP BY pcf_violation_category
),
y11 AS (
  SELECT pcf_violation_category AS cat, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM collisions
  WHERE substr(collision_date,1,4)='2011'
  GROUP BY pcf_violation_category
),
t21 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM y21),
t11 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM y11),
top AS (
  SELECT cat FROM y21 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT 100.0*cnt/(SELECT total FROM t11) FROM y11 WHERE cat=(SELECT cat FROM top))
  -
  (SELECT 100.0*cnt/(SELECT total FROM t21) FROM y21 WHERE cat=(SELECT cat FROM top))
  AS decrease_percentage_points;

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.match_id,
           bb.innings_no,
           bb.over_id,
           bb.bowler,
           SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
        ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
       AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
       AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
       AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
        ON bb.match_id = er.match_id
       AND bb.over_id = er.over_id
       AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id
       AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.innings_no, bb.over_id, bb.bowler
),
match_max AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(runs_conceded) AS max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
top_overs AS (
    SELECT o.*
    FROM over_runs o
    JOIN match_max m
      ON o.match_id = m.match_id
     AND o.runs_conceded = m.max_runs
),
bowler_totals AS (
    SELECT bowler, SUM(runs_conceded) AS total_runs
    FROM top_overs
    GROUP BY bowler
    ORDER BY total_runs DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT p.player_name,
       t.name AS team_name,
       bt.total_runs,
       o.match_id,
       o.runs_conceded AS max_over_runs
FROM bowler_totals bt
JOIN over_runs o
  ON o.bowler = bt.bowler
JOIN match_max m
  ON o.match_id = m.match_id
 AND o.runs_conceded = m.max_runs
JOIN player p
  ON p.player_id = bt.bowler
JOIN team t
  ON t.team_id = o.bowler
ORDER BY bt.total_runs DESC, o.runs_conceded DESC;

     AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id
     AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.over_id, bb.innings_no, bb.bowler
),
max_per_match AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(runs_conceded) AS max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
top_overs AS (
    SELECT o.*
    FROM over_runs o
    JOIN max_per_match m
      ON o.match_id = m.match_id

),
bowler_totals AS (
    SELECT bowler, SUM(runs_conceded) AS total_runs
    FROM top_overs
    GROUP BY bowler
    ORDER BY total_runs DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT p.player_name,
       t.match_id,
       t.runs_conceded
FROM top_overs t
JOIN bowler_totals bt
  ON t.bowler = bt.bowler
JOIN player p
  ON t.bowler = p.player_id

           bb.bowler,
           SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
      ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
     AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
     AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
     AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
      ON bb.match_id = er.match_id
     AND bb.over_id = er.over_id
     AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id
     AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.over_id, bb.innings_no, bb.bowler
),
max_over_per_match AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(runs_conceded) AS max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
top_overs AS (
    SELECT o.*
    FROM over_runs o
    JOIN max_over_per_match m
      ON o.match_id = m.match_id
     AND o.runs_conceded = m.max_runs
),
bowler_totals AS (
    SELECT bowler, SUM(runs_conceded) AS total_runs
    FROM top_overs
    GROUP BY bowler
    ORDER BY total_runs DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT p.player_name,
       t.match_id,
       t.runs_conceded
FROM top_overs t
JOIN bowler_totals bt
  ON t.bowler = bt.bowler
JOIN player p
  ON t.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bt.total_runs DESC, t.runs_conceded DESC;

SELECT b.bowler, p.player_name, 
       SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) * 1.0 / COUNT(wt.player_out) AS bowling_average
FROM ball_by_ball b
JOIN player p ON b.bowler = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON b.match_id = wt.match_id AND b.over_id = wt.over_id AND b.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND b.innings_no = wt.innings_no
GROUP BY b.bowler
HAVING COUNT(wt.player_out) > 0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.bowler, p.player_name, 
       SUM(bs.runs_scored + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT wt.player_out) AS bowling_average
FROM ball_by_ball b
JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON b.match_id = wt.match_id AND b.over_id = wt.over_id AND b.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND b.innings_no = wt.innings_no
JOIN player p ON b.bowler = p.player_id
GROUP BY b.bowler
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT wt.player_out) > 0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.bowler, p.player_name, AVG(b.runs_conceded) AS bowling_average
FROM (
    SELECT bb.match_id, bb.innings_no, bb.over_id, bb.ball_id, bb.bowler,
           COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) AS runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
      ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
     AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
      ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id
     AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM extra_runs er2
        WHERE er2.match_id = bb.match_id AND er2.over_id = bb.over_id
          AND er2.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND er2.innings_no = bb.innings_no
          AND er2.extra_type IN ('byes', 'legbyes')
    )
) b
JOIN player p ON b.bowler = p.player_id
JOIN (
    SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN wicket_taken wt
      ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id
     AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    WHERE wt.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
    GROUP BY bowler
) w ON b.bowler = w.bowler
GROUP BY b.bowler, p.player_name
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(total_runs) FROM (SELECT bbb.match_id, bbb.striker, SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs FROM ball_by_ball bbb JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no GROUP BY bbb.match_id, bbb.striker HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) > 50);

SELECT AVG(total_runs) FROM (SELECT bbb.match_id, bbb.striker, SUM(bs.runs_scored + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs FROM ball_by_ball bbb JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bbb.match_id = er.match_id AND bbb.over_id = er.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = er.innings_no GROUP BY bbb.match_id, bbb.striker HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) > 50);

SELECT AVG(total_runs) FROM (

    FROM ball_by_ball bbb

        ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er

        AND bbb.over_id = er.over_id
        AND bbb.ball_id = er.ball_id
        AND bbb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.match_id, bbb.striker
    HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) > 50
);

WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT
        pm.player_id,
        bbb.match_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) AS runs_in_match
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb
        ON bbb.striker = pm.player_id
        AND bbb.match_id = pm.match_id
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
        ON bs.match_id = bbb.match_id
        AND bs.over_id = bbb.over_id
        AND bs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id
        AND bs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, bbb.match_id
),
player_avg AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        AVG(runs_in_match) AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT
    p.country_name,
    AVG(pa.avg_runs_per_match) AS country_batting_average
FROM player_avg pa
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
GROUP BY p.country_name
ORDER BY country_batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT p.country_name, AVG(player_avg_runs) AS country_batting_average
FROM (
    SELECT pm.player_id, AVG(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) AS player_avg_runs
    FROM player_match pm
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
        ON pm.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND pm.player_id = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
) AS pa
JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY p.country_name
ORDER BY country_batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT p.country_name,
       AVG(player_avg.avg_runs) AS country_batting_average
FROM (
    SELECT pm.player_id,
           SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS avg_runs
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN player p2 ON p2.player_id = pm.player_id
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
        ON bs.match_id = pm.match_id
        AND bs.innings_no IN (
            SELECT innings_no FROM ball_by_ball b
            WHERE b.match_id = pm.match_id AND b.striker = pm.player_id
        )
        AND bs.over_id IN (
            SELECT over_id FROM ball_by_ball b
            WHERE b.match_id = pm.match_id AND b.striker = pm.player_id
        )
        AND bs.ball_id IN (
            SELECT ball_id FROM ball_by_ball b
            WHERE b.match_id = pm.match_id AND b.striker = pm.player_id
        )
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
        ON er.match_id = pm.match_id
        AND er.innings_no IN (
            SELECT innings_no FROM ball_by_ball b
            WHERE b.match_id = pm.match_id AND b.striker = pm.player_id
        )
        AND er.over_id IN (
            SELECT over_id FROM ball_by_ball b
            WHERE b.match_id = pm.match_id AND b.striker = pm.player_id
        )
        AND er.ball_id IN (
            SELECT ball_id FROM ball_by_ball b
            WHERE b.match_id = pm.match_id AND b.striker = pm.player_id
        )
    GROUP BY pm.player_id

JOIN player p ON p.player_id = player_avg.player_id
GROUP BY p.country_name
ORDER BY country_batting_average DESC
LIMIT 5;

    FROM (

        FROM ball_by_ball
    ) bb
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs
        FROM batsman_scored
        GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
    ) bs
        ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id

        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
    LEFT JOIN (

        FROM extra_runs
        GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id

),

    FROM over_runs
)

SELECT 
    strftime('%m', order_delivered_customer_date) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) = '2016' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "2016",
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) = '2017' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "2017",
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) = '2018' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "2018"
FROM olist_orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
    AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) IN ('2016', '2017', '2018')
GROUP BY strftime('%m', order_delivered_customer_date)
ORDER BY month;

FROM (

    FROM olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
      AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
      AND strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) IN ('2016', '2017', '2018')

  FROM usd

FROM ordered
WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2);

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    t.calendar_year AS yr,
    t.calendar_month_number AS mon,
    SUM(s.amount_sold) AS dollars
  FROM sales s
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  JOIN promotions pr ON s.promo_id = pr.promo_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
    AND pr.promo_total_id = 1
    AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
  GROUP BY t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
y2019 AS (
  SELECT mon, dollars FROM monthly WHERE yr = 2019
),
y2020 AS (
  SELECT mon, dollars FROM monthly WHERE yr = 2020
),
growth AS (
  SELECT
    a.mon,
    CASE WHEN a.dollars = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (b.dollars - a.dollars) / a.dollars END AS g
  FROM y2019 a
  JOIN y2020 b ON a.mon = b.mon
),
proj AS (
  SELECT
    b.mon,
    b.dollars * (1 + COALESCE(g.g, 0)) AS proj_dollars
  FROM y2020 b
  LEFT JOIN growth g ON b.mon = g.mon
),
proj_usd AS (
  SELECT
    p.mon,
    p.proj_dollars * cur.to_us AS usd
  FROM proj p
  JOIN currency cur
    ON cur.country = 'France'
   AND cur.year = 2021
   AND cur.month = p.mon
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT usd,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY usd) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
  FROM proj_usd
)
SELECT AVG(usd) AS median_projected_monthly_sales_usd
FROM ranked
WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2);

WITH customer_profits AS (
  SELECT
    c.cust_id,
    SUM(s.quantity_sold * (cst.unit_price - cst.unit_cost)) AS total_profit
  FROM customers c
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN costs cst ON cst.prod_id = s.prod_id
                 AND cst.time_id = s.time_id
                 AND cst.channel_id = s.channel_id
                 AND cst.promo_id = s.promo_id
  JOIN times t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
    AND t.calendar_month_desc = '2021-12'
  GROUP BY c.cust_id
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT MIN(total_profit) AS min_p, MAX(total_profit) AS max_p FROM customer_profits
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    cp.cust_id,
    cp.total_profit,
    CASE
      WHEN (SELECT max_p - min_p FROM bounds) = 0 THEN 1
      ELSE MIN(10, CAST((cp.total_profit - (SELECT min_p FROM bounds)) * 10.0 / ((SELECT max_p - min_p FROM bounds)) AS INTEGER) + 1)
    END AS bucket
  FROM customer_profits cp
)
SELECT
  bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS num_customers,
  MIN(total_profit) AS min_total_profit,
  MAX(total_profit) AS max_total_profit
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket;

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%Y', insert_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    CAST(strftime('%m', insert_date) AS INTEGER) AS month_num,
    COUNT(*) AS city_count
  FROM cities
  WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', insert_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2023
    AND CAST(strftime('%m', insert_date) AS INTEGER) IN (4, 5, 6)
  GROUP BY year, month_num
),
filled AS (
  SELECT y.year, m.month_num, COALESCE(mc.city_count, 0) AS city_count
  FROM (SELECT 2021 AS year UNION ALL SELECT 2022 UNION ALL SELECT 2023) y
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT 4 AS month_num UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6) m
  LEFT JOIN monthly_counts mc ON mc.year = y.year AND mc.month_num = m.month_num
),
running AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    month_num,
    city_count,
    SUM(city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
  FROM filled
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    month_num,
    city_count,
    running_total,
    LAG(city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year) AS prev_city_count,
    LAG(running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month_num ORDER BY year) AS prev_running_total
  FROM running
)
SELECT
  year,
  CASE month_num WHEN 4 THEN 'April' WHEN 5 THEN 'May' WHEN 6 THEN 'June' END AS month,
  city_count AS total_cities_added,
  running_total AS cumulative_running_total,
  CASE WHEN prev_city_count IS NULL OR prev_city_count = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND((city_count - prev_city_count) * 100.0 / prev_city_count, 2) END AS yoy_growth_monthly_total_pct,
  CASE WHEN prev_running_total IS NULL OR prev_running_total = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE ROUND((running_total - prev_running_total) * 100.0 / prev_running_total, 2) END AS yoy_growth_running_total_pct
FROM with_prev
WHERE year IN (2022, 2023)
ORDER BY month_num, year;

),
filled AS (
  SELECT g.year, g.month, COALESCE(m.cnt,0) AS cnt
  FROM grid g
  LEFT JOIN monthly m ON m.year=g.year AND m.month=g.month
),
with_running AS (
  SELECT year, month, cnt,
         SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
  FROM filled
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT year, month, cnt, running_total,
         LAG(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS prev_cnt,
         LAG(running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS prev_running
  FROM with_running
)
SELECT year, month, cnt AS total_cities_added,
       running_total,
       CASE WHEN prev_cnt IS NULL OR prev_cnt = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((cnt - prev_cnt) * 100.0 / prev_cnt, 2) END AS monthly_yoy_growth_pct,
       CASE WHEN prev_running IS NULL OR prev_running = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND((running_total - prev_running) * 100.0 / prev_running, 2) END AS running_yoy_growth_pct
FROM with_prev
WHERE year IN (2022, 2023)
ORDER BY month, year;

WITH order_pizzas AS (
  SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.order_id) AS row_id,
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.pizza_id,
    o.exclusions,
    o.extras,
    o.order_time,
    CASE WHEN o.pizza_id = 1 THEN 'Meatlovers' ELSE 'Vegetarian' END AS pizza_name
  FROM pizza_customer_orders o
),
ingredients AS (
  SELECT
    op.row_id,
    op.order_id,
    op.customer_id,
    op.pizza_name,
    op.order_time,
    TRIM(t.topping_name) AS topping_name
  FROM order_pizzas op
  JOIN pizza_recipes r ON r.pizza_id = op.pizza_id
  JOIN pizza_toppings t ON ',' || REPLACE(r.toppings, ' ', '') || ',' LIKE '%,' || t.topping_id || ',%'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    op.row_id,
    op.order_id,
    op.customer_id,
    op.pizza_name,
    op.order_time,
    TRIM(t.topping_name) AS topping_name
  FROM order_pizzas op
  JOIN pizza_toppings t ON op.extras IS NOT NULL
    AND ',' || REPLACE(op.extras, ' ', '') || ',' LIKE '%,' || t.topping_id || ',%'
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT i.*
  FROM ingredients i
  JOIN order_pizzas op ON op.row_id = i.row_id
  WHERE op.exclusions IS NULL
     OR NOT EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM pizza_toppings t2
       WHERE ',' || REPLACE(op.exclusions, ' ', '') || ',' LIKE '%,' || t2.topping_id || ',%'
         AND t2.topping_name = i.topping_name
     )
),
counted AS (
  SELECT
    row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time, topping_name,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time, topping_name
),
formatted AS (
  SELECT
    row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time,
    GROUP_CONCAT(
      CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN cnt || 'x' || topping_name ELSE topping_name END,
      ', '
    ) AS ingredient_list
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM counted
    ORDER BY row_id, CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, topping_name
  )
  GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time
)
SELECT
  row_id,
  order_id,
  customer_id,
  pizza_name,
  pizza_name || ': ' || COALESCE(ingredient_list, '') AS ingredients
FROM formatted
ORDER BY row_id ASC;

SELECT
  pco.rowid AS row_id,
  pco.order_id,
  pco.customer_id,
  pn.pizza_name,
  pn.pizza_name || ': ' || GROUP_CONCAT(
    CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN cnt || 'x' || topping_name ELSE topping_name END,
    ', '
  ) AS ingredients
FROM (
  SELECT
    rowid,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_id,
    order_time
  FROM pizza_customer_orders
) pco
JOIN pizza_names pn ON pn.pizza_id = pco.pizza_id
JOIN (
  SELECT
    pco2.rowid AS rid,
    t.topping_name,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM pizza_customer_orders pco2
  JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON pr.pizza_id = pco2.pizza_id
  JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id IN (
    SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM json_each('[' || pr.toppings || ']')
  )
  WHERE (pco2.exclusions IS NULL OR pco2.exclusions = '' OR t.topping_id NOT IN (
    SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM json_each('[' || pco2.exclusions || ']')
  ))
  GROUP BY pco2.rowid, t.topping_name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    pco3.rowid AS rid,
    t2.topping_name,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM pizza_customer_orders pco3
  JOIN pizza_toppings t2 ON t2.topping_id IN (
    SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM json_each('[' || pco3.extras || ']')
  )
  WHERE pco3.extras IS NOT NULL AND pco3.extras <> ''
  GROUP BY pco3.rowid, t2.topping_name
) ing ON ing.rid = pco.rowid
GROUP BY pco.rowid, pco.order_id, pn.pizza_name, pco.order_time
ORDER BY pco.rowid ASC;

WITH order_data AS (
  SELECT
    co.rowid AS row_id,
    co.order_id,
    co.customer_id,
    co.pizza_id,
    co.extras,
    co.exclusions,
    co.order_time
  FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders co
),
pizza_info AS (
  SELECT
    od.row_id,
    od.order_id,
    od.customer_id,
    od.order_time,
    CASE WHEN od.pizza_id = 1 THEN 'Meatlovers' ELSE 'Vegetarian' END AS pizza_name,
    od.extras,
    od.exclusions,
    pr.toppings AS recipe_toppings
  FROM order_data od
  LEFT JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON pr.pizza_id = od.pizza_id
),
exploded AS (
  SELECT
    pi.row_id,
    pi.order_id,
    pi.customer_id,
    pi.pizza_name,
    pi.order_time,
    pi.extras,
    pi.exclusions,
    pi.recipe_toppings,
    t.topping_name,
    CASE WHEN pi.extras IS NOT NULL AND pi.extras <> '' AND instr(',' || replace(pi.extras, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || CAST(t.topping_id AS TEXT) || ',') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_extra,
    CASE WHEN pi.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND pi.exclusions <> '' AND instr(',' || replace(pi.exclusions, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || CAST(t.topping_id AS TEXT) || ',') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_excluded
  FROM pizza_info pi
  JOIN pizza_toppings t
    ON instr(',' || replace(pi.recipe_toppings, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || CAST(t.topping_id AS TEXT) || ',') > 0
    OR (pi.extras IS NOT NULL AND pi.extras <> '' AND instr(',' || replace(pi.extras, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || CAST(t.topping_id AS TEXT) || ',') > 0)
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    order_time,
    topping_name,
    CASE WHEN is_extra = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS cnt
  FROM exploded
  WHERE is_excluded = 0
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    order_time,
    topping_name,
    SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time, topping_name
),
formatted AS (
  SELECT
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    order_time,
    GROUP_CONCAT(
      CASE WHEN total_cnt > 1 THEN '2x' || topping_name ELSE topping_name END,
      ', '
    ) AS ingredients_str
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM aggregated
    ORDER BY row_id, CASE WHEN total_cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, topping_name
  )
  GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time
)
SELECT
  row_id,
  order_id,
  customer_id,
  pizza_name,
  pizza_name || ': ' || ingredients_str AS ingredients
FROM formatted
ORDER BY row_id ASC;

WITH monthly_activity AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS monthly_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date)
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS month
  FROM customer_transactions
),
customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
grid AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, m.month
  FROM customers c
  CROSS JOIN all_months m
),
filled AS (
  SELECT
    g.customer_id,
    g.month,
    COALESCE(ma.monthly_change, 0) AS monthly_change
  FROM grid g
  LEFT JOIN monthly_activity ma
    ON ma.customer_id = g.customer_id AND ma.month = g.month
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  month,
  SUM(monthly_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS closing_balance,
  monthly_change,
  SUM(monthly_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_balance
FROM filled
ORDER BY customer_id, month;

WITH monthly_net AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date)
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS month FROM customer_transactions
),
customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
grid AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, m.month
  FROM customers c CROSS JOIN all_months m
)
SELECT
  g.customer_id,
  g.month,
  COALESCE(mn.net_change, 0) AS monthly_change,
  SUM(COALESCE(mn.net_change, 0)) OVER (
    PARTITION BY g.customer_id
    ORDER BY g.month
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS closing_balance
FROM grid g
LEFT JOIN monthly_net mn
  ON mn.customer_id = g.customer_id AND mn.month = g.month
ORDER BY g.customer_id, g.month;

WITH monthly_activity AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS monthly_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date)
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS month
  FROM customer_transactions
),
customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
grid AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, m.month
  FROM customers c CROSS JOIN all_months m
),
filled AS (
  SELECT
    g.customer_id,
    g.month,
    COALESCE(a.monthly_change, 0) AS monthly_change
  FROM grid g
  LEFT JOIN monthly_activity a
    ON a.customer_id = g.customer_id AND a.month = g.month
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  month,
  SUM(monthly_change) OVER (
    PARTITION BY customer_id
    ORDER BY month
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS closing_balance,
  monthly_change,
  SUM(monthly_change) OVER (
    PARTITION BY customer_id
    ORDER BY month
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS cumulative_balance
FROM filled
ORDER BY customer_id, month;

WITH monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS month_num,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE strftime('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
    GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%m', txn_date)
),
positive_counts AS (
    SELECT
        month_num,
        COUNT(*) AS positive_count
    FROM monthly_balances
    WHERE balance > 0
    GROUP BY month_num
),
max_month AS (
    SELECT month_num FROM positive_counts ORDER BY positive_count DESC, month_num ASC LIMIT 1
),
min_month AS (
    SELECT month_num FROM positive_counts ORDER BY positive_count ASC, month_num ASC LIMIT 1
),
avg_balances AS (
    SELECT
        month_num,
        AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM monthly_balances
    GROUP BY month_num
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE month_num = (SELECT month_num FROM max_month))
    -
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE month_num = (SELECT month_num FROM min_month)) AS avg_difference;

WITH monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%m', txn_date) AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) -
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE strftime('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
    GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%m', txn_date)
),
monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        COUNT(*) AS positive_count,
        AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM monthly_balances
    WHERE balance > 0
    GROUP BY month
),
all_months AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_count,
        AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM monthly_balances
    GROUP BY month
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        positive_count,
        avg_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count DESC, month) AS rn_high,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY positive_count ASC, month) AS rn_low
    FROM all_months
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked WHERE rn_high = 1) -
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM ranked WHERE rn_low = 1) AS avg_balance_difference;

WITH monthly_balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%m', txn_date) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS balance
  FROM customer_transactions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
  GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%m', txn_date)
),
positive_counts AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    COUNT(*) AS positive_customers,
    AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM monthly_balances
  WHERE balance > 0
  GROUP BY month
),
all_month_avgs AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
  FROM monthly_balances
  GROUP BY month
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    positive_customers,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY positive_customers DESC) AS r_desc,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY positive_customers ASC) AS r_asc
  FROM positive_counts
)
SELECT
  (SELECT a.avg_balance FROM all_month_avgs a JOIN ranked r ON a.month = r.month WHERE r.r_desc = 1)
  -
  (SELECT a.avg_balance FROM all_month_avgs a JOIN ranked r ON a.month = r.month WHERE r.r_asc = 1)
  AS avg_balance_difference;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m-01', txn_date) AS month_start,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
             WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
             ELSE 0 END) AS net_amount
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m-01', txn_date)
),
balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    month_start,
    SUM(net_amount) OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_id
      ORDER BY month_start
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS closing_balance
  FROM monthly
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    month_start,
    closing_balance,
    LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC) AS rn
  FROM balances
),
latest AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    closing_balance,
    prev_balance,
    CASE
      WHEN prev_balance IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN prev_balance = 0 THEN closing_balance * 100
      ELSE (closing_balance - prev_balance) * 100.0 / prev_balance
    END AS growth_rate
  FROM with_prev
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_customers
FROM latest
WHERE growth_rate IS NOT NULL;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    substr(txn_date, 1, 7) AS ym,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date, 1, 7)
),
balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    ym,
    SUM(net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY ym ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS closing_balance
  FROM monthly
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    ym,
    closing_balance,
    LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY ym) AS prev_balance
  FROM balances
),
latest AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    closing_balance,
    prev_balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY ym DESC) AS rn
  FROM with_prev
),
growth AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    CASE
      WHEN prev_balance IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN prev_balance = 0 THEN closing_balance * 100.0
      ELSE (closing_balance - prev_balance) * 100.0 / prev_balance
    END AS growth_rate
  FROM latest
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_customers
FROM growth
WHERE growth_rate IS NOT NULL;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         strftime('%Y-%m-01', txn_date) AS month_start,
         SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                  WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
                  ELSE 0 END) AS net_amount
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m-01', txn_date)
),
balances AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         month_start,
         SUM(net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start
                               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS closing_balance
  FROM monthly
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         month_start,
         closing_balance,
         LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_balance,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC) AS rn
  FROM balances
),
growth AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         CASE WHEN prev_balance IS NULL OR prev_balance = 0
              THEN closing_balance * 100.0
              ELSE (closing_balance - prev_balance) * 100.0 / prev_balance
         END AS growth_rate
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_customers
FROM growth;

WITH monthly_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT substr(txn_date, 1, 7) AS month_str
    FROM customer_transactions
),
month_bounds AS (
    SELECT month_str,
           month_str || '-01' AS month_start
    FROM monthly_dates
),
balances AS (
    SELECT
        mb.month_str,
        mb.month_start,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN ct.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN ct.txn_amount
                WHEN ct.txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -ct.txn_amount
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS balance
    FROM month_bounds mb
    LEFT JOIN customer_transactions ct
        ON ct.txn_date < mb.month_start
    GROUP BY mb.month_str, mb.month_start
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        month_str,
        month_start,
        balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS rn
    FROM balances
)
SELECT
    month_str AS month,
    CASE WHEN balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance END AS total_balance
FROM ranked
WHERE rn > 1
ORDER BY month_start ASC;

WITH monthly_balances AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS month,
    customer_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS balance
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date), customer_id
),
running AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    customer_id,
    SUM(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS cum_balance
  FROM monthly_balances
),
first_month AS (
  SELECT MIN(month) AS fm FROM monthly_balances
)
SELECT
  r.month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN r.cum_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE r.cum_balance END) AS total_balance
FROM running r
JOIN first_month f ON 1=1
WHERE r.month > f.fm
  AND r.month = (
    SELECT MAX(r2.month)
    FROM running r2
    WHERE r2.customer_id = r.customer_id
      AND r2.month < r.month
  )
GROUP BY r.month
ORDER BY r.month ASC;

WITH monthly_balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS balance
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date)
),
running_balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    month,
    SUM(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_balance
  FROM monthly_balances
),
month_ends AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT month FROM monthly_balances
),
prev_month_balances AS (
  SELECT
    m.month AS current_month,
    r.customer_id,
    r.cumulative_balance
  FROM month_ends m
  LEFT JOIN running_balances r
    ON r.month = (
      SELECT MAX(month) FROM running_balances r2
      WHERE r2.customer_id = r.customer_id AND r2.month < m.month
    )
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    current_month AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cumulative_balance > 0 THEN cumulative_balance ELSE 0 END) AS total_balance
  FROM prev_month_balances
  GROUP BY current_month
),
first_month AS (
  SELECT MIN(month) AS fm FROM monthly_balances
)
SELECT month, total_balance
FROM aggregated
WHERE month > (SELECT fm FROM first_month)
ORDER BY month ASC;

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS day_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
balances AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    SUM(day_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS balance
  FROM daily
),
rolling AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    AVG(balance) OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_id
      ORDER BY txn_date
      ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS avg_30,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_id
      ORDER BY txn_date
      ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cnt_30
  FROM balances
),
valid_rolling AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    CASE WHEN cnt_30 = 30 AND avg_30 > 0 THEN avg_30 ELSE 0 END AS avg_30
  FROM rolling
),
monthly_max AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS month,
    MAX(avg_30) AS max_avg
  FROM valid_rolling
  GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date)
),
first_month AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MIN(strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date)) AS first_month
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
  mm.month,
  SUM(mm.max_avg) AS total_max_avg
FROM monthly_max mm
JOIN first_month fm
  ON mm.customer_id = fm.customer_id

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date,
         SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS day_change
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
balances AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date,
         SUM(day_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date
                               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS balance
  FROM daily
),
rolling AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, balance,
         AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date
                            ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg30,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date
                        ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cnt30
  FROM balances
),
adj AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date,
         CASE WHEN cnt30 >= 30 AND avg30 > 0 THEN avg30 ELSE 0 END AS avg30_adj
  FROM rolling
),
monthly_max AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS month,
         MAX(avg30_adj) AS max_avg
  FROM adj
  GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date)
),
first_month AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date)) AS first_month
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT mm.month, SUM(mm.max_avg) AS total_max_avg
FROM monthly_max mm
JOIN first_month fm ON fm.customer_id = mm.customer_id
WHERE mm.month > fm.first_month
GROUP BY mm.month
ORDER BY mm.month;

WITH date_bounds AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         MIN(txn_date) AS min_date,
         MAX(txn_date) AS max_date
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
recursive_dates AS (
  SELECT customer_id, min_date AS d, max_date
  FROM date_bounds
  UNION ALL
  SELECT customer_id, date(d, '+1 day'), max_date
  FROM recursive_dates
  WHERE date(d, '+1 day') <= max_date
),
daily_net AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date AS d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
daily_balances AS (
  SELECT rd.customer_id, rd.d,
         SUM(COALESCE(dn.net, 0)) OVER (
           PARTITION BY rd.customer_id ORDER BY rd.d
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
         ) AS balance
  FROM recursive_dates rd
  LEFT JOIN daily_net dn ON dn.customer_id = rd.customer_id AND dn.d = rd.d
),
clamped AS (
  SELECT customer_id, d,
         CASE WHEN balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance END AS balance
  FROM daily_balances
),
monthly_max AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         strftime('%Y-%m', d) AS month,
         MAX(balance) AS max_balance
  FROM clamped
  GROUP BY customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', d)
)
SELECT month, SUM(max_balance) AS total_monthly_balance
FROM monthly_max
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

WITH RECURSIVE date_bounds AS (

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    m.month_year,
    m._year,
    m._month,
    i.interest_name,
    AVG(m.composition / m.index_value) AS avg_composition
  FROM interest_metrics m
  JOIN interest_map i ON i.id = m.interest_id
  WHERE (m._year = 2018 AND m._month >= 9)
     OR (m._year = 2019 AND m._month <= 8)
  GROUP BY m.month_year, m._year, m._month, i.interest_name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    monthly.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_composition DESC) AS rn
  FROM monthly
),
top AS (
  SELECT month_year, _year, _month, interest_name, avg_composition
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
),
with_prev AS (
  SELECT
    t.month_year,
    t.interest_name,
    t.avg_composition AS max_index_composition,
    AVG(t.avg_composition) OVER (
      ORDER BY t._year, t._month
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS rolling_avg,
    LAG(t.interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY t._year, t._month) AS prev1_name,
    LAG(t.avg_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY t._year, t._month) AS prev1_comp,
    LAG(t.interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY t._year, t._month) AS prev2_name,
    LAG(t.avg_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY t._year, t._month) AS prev2_comp
  FROM top t
)
SELECT
  month_year AS date,
  interest_name,
  max_index_composition,
  rolling_avg,
  prev1_name AS interest_name_1_month_ago,
  prev1_comp AS max_index_composition_1_month_ago,
  prev2_name AS interest_name_2_months_ago,
  prev2_comp AS max_index_composition_2_months_ago
FROM with_prev
ORDER BY date;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    m.month_year AS month_year,
    m._year AS yr,
    m._month AS mo,
    i.interest_name AS interest_name,
    AVG(m.composition / m.index_value) AS avg_composition
  FROM interest_metrics m
  JOIN interest_map i ON i.id = m.interest_id
  WHERE (m._year = 2018 AND m._month >= 9) OR (m._year = 2019 AND m._month <= 8)
  GROUP BY m.month_year, m._year, m._month, i.interest_name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    month_year, yr, mo, interest_name, avg_composition,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_composition DESC) AS rn
  FROM monthly
),
maxes AS (
  SELECT month_year, yr, mo, interest_name, avg_composition
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
),
rolling AS (
  SELECT
    month_year, yr, mo, interest_name, avg_composition,
    AVG(avg_composition) OVER (
      ORDER BY yr, mo
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS rolling_avg
  FROM maxes
)
SELECT
  r.month_year AS date,
  r.interest_name AS interest_name,
  r.avg_composition AS max_index_composition,
  r.rolling_avg AS rolling_average,
  m1.interest_name AS interest_name_1_month_ago,
  m1.avg_composition AS max_index_composition_1_month_ago,
  m2.interest_name AS interest_name_2_months_ago,
  m2.avg_composition AS max_index_composition_2_months_ago
FROM rolling r
LEFT JOIN maxes m1
  ON (m1.yr = r.yr AND m1.mo = r.mo - 1)
  OR (r.mo = 1 AND m1.yr = r.yr - 1 AND m1.mo = 12)
LEFT JOIN maxes m2
  ON (m2.yr = r.yr AND m2.mo = r.mo - 2)
  OR (r.mo = 2 AND m2.yr = r.yr - 1 AND m2.mo = 12)
  OR (r.mo = 1 AND m2.yr = r.yr - 1 AND m2.mo = 11)
ORDER BY r.yr, r.mo;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    m.month_year AS month_year,
    i.interest_name AS interest_name,
    AVG(m.composition / m.index_value) AS avg_composition
  FROM interest_metrics m
  JOIN interest_map i ON i.id = m.interest_id
  WHERE (m._year = 2018 AND m._month >= 9) OR (m._year = 2019 AND m._month <= 8)
  GROUP BY m.month_year, i.interest_name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    month_year,
    interest_name,
    avg_composition,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_composition DESC) AS rn
  FROM monthly
),
maxes AS (
  SELECT month_year, interest_name, avg_composition
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
),
with_rolling AS (
  SELECT
    month_year,
    interest_name,
    avg_composition,
    AVG(avg_composition) OVER (ORDER BY month_year ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg
  FROM maxes
)
SELECT
  w.month_year AS date,
  w.interest_name AS interest_name,
  w.avg_composition AS max_index_composition,
  w.rolling_avg AS rolling_average,
  m1.interest_name AS interest_name_1_month_ago,
  m1.avg_composition AS max_index_composition_1_month_ago,
  m2.interest_name AS interest_name_2_months_ago,
  m2.avg_composition AS max_index_composition_2_months_ago
FROM with_rolling w
LEFT JOIN maxes m1
  ON m1.month_year = strftime('%Y-%m', date(w.month_year || '-01', '-1 month'))
LEFT JOIN maxes m2
  ON m2.month_year = strftime('%Y-%m', date(w.month_year || '-01', '-2 months'))
ORDER BY w.month_year;

SELECT
    cgt.groupname AS spending_group,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o2.customerid)
                              FROM orders o2
                              WHERE o2.orderdate >= '1998-01-01'
                                AND o2.orderdate < '1999-01-01'), 2) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT
        o.customerid,
        SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity) AS total_spent
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_details od ON od.orderid = o.orderid
    WHERE o.orderdate >= '1998-01-01'
      AND o.orderdate < '1999-01-01'
    GROUP BY o.customerid
) cs
JOIN customergroupthreshold cgt
  ON cs.total_spent >= cgt.rangebottom
 AND cs.total_spent < cgt.rangetop
GROUP BY cgt.groupname, cgt.rangebottom, cgt.rangetop
ORDER BY cgt.rangebottom;

SELECT
    cgt.groupname,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customerid) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.customerid) * 100.0 /
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o2.customerid)
         FROM orders o2
         WHERE o2.orderdate >= '1998-01-01' AND o2.orderdate < '1999-01-01'),
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customerid = o.customerid
JOIN order_details od ON o.orderid = od.orderid
JOIN customergroupthreshold cgt
    ON (od.unitprice * od.quantity) >= cgt.rangebottom
   AND (od.unitprice * od.quantity) < cgt.rangetop
WHERE o.orderdate >= '1998-01-01' AND o.orderdate < '1999-01-01'
GROUP BY cgt.groupname;

WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT
        o.customerid,
        SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity) AS total_spent
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_details od ON o.orderid = od.orderid
    WHERE o.orderdate >= '1998-01-01' AND o.orderdate < '1999-01-01'
    GROUP BY o.customerid
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT
        cs.customerid,
        cs.total_spent,
        (
            SELECT cgt.groupname
            FROM customergroupthreshold cgt
            WHERE cs.total_spent >= cgt.rangebottom
              AND cs.total_spent <= cgt.rangetop
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS groupname
    FROM customer_spending cs
)
SELECT
    groupname,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_customers,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_spending), 2) AS percentage
FROM grouped
GROUP BY groupname
ORDER BY groupname;

SELECT
  m.year_num AS year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.MID) AS total_movies,
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.has_female = 1 AND m.has_nonfemale = 0 THEN m.MID END) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.MID) AS percentage
FROM (
  SELECT
    Movie.MID,
    CAST(substr(Movie.year, -4) AS INTEGER) AS year_num,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Person.Gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_female,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Person.Gender IS NULL OR Person.Gender IN ('Male', 'None') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_nonfemale
  FROM Movie
  JOIN M_Cast ON Movie.MID = M_Cast.MID
  JOIN Person ON M_Cast.PID = Person.PID
  GROUP BY Movie.MID, CAST(substr(Movie.year, -4) AS INTEGER)
) AS m
GROUP BY m.year_num
ORDER BY m.year_num;

WITH movie_years AS (
  SELECT MID, CAST(substr(year, -4) AS INTEGER) AS yr
  FROM Movie
  WHERE year IS NOT NULL
),
movie_gender AS (
  SELECT my.MID, my.yr,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.Gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.Gender = 'Male' OR p.Gender = 'None' OR p.Gender IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_female_count
  FROM movie_years my
  JOIN M_Cast mc ON mc.MID = my.MID
  LEFT JOIN Person p ON p.PID = mc.PID
  GROUP BY my.MID, my.yr
),
exclusive_female AS (
  SELECT MID, yr
  FROM movie_gender
  WHERE female_count > 0 AND non_female_count = 0
)
SELECT my.yr AS year,
       COUNT(DISTINCT my.MID) AS total_movies,
       100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT ef.MID) / COUNT(DISTINCT my.MID) AS percentage_exclusive_female
FROM movie_years my
LEFT JOIN exclusive_female ef ON ef.MID = my.MID
GROUP BY my.yr
ORDER BY my.yr;

SELECT
  CAST(substr(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.MID) AS total_movies,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN male_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.MID) AS pct_exclusively_female
FROM Movie m
JOIN (
  SELECT
    mc.MID,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.Gender IN ('Male', 'None') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count
  FROM M_Cast mc
  JOIN Person p ON p.PID = mc.PID
  GROUP BY mc.MID
) cast_stats ON cast_stats.MID = m.MID
GROUP BY CAST(substr(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER);

WITH actor_years AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT mc.PID, CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) AS year
  FROM M_Cast mc
  JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
  WHERE m.year GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]'
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT a.PID,
         MAX(b.year - a.year) AS max_gap
  FROM actor_years a
  JOIN actor_years b ON a.PID = b.PID AND b.year > a.year
  GROUP BY a.PID
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PID)
FROM actor_years
WHERE PID NOT IN (
  SELECT PID FROM gaps WHERE max_gap > 3
);

WITH rep_sales AS (
  SELECT
    r.id AS region_id,
    r.name AS region_name,
    s.id AS rep_id,
    s.name AS rep_name,
    COUNT(o.id) AS order_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amt_usd), 0) AS total_sales
  FROM web_region r
  JOIN web_sales_reps s ON s.region_id = r.id
  LEFT JOIN web_accounts a ON a.sales_rep_id = s.id
  LEFT JOIN web_orders o ON o.account_id = a.id
  GROUP BY r.id, r.name, s.id, s.name
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.id AS region_id,
    r.name AS region_name,
    COUNT(o.id) AS total_orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amt_usd), 0) AS region_total_sales
  FROM web_region r
  LEFT JOIN web_sales_reps s ON s.region_id = r.id
  LEFT JOIN web_accounts a ON a.sales_rep_id = s.id
  LEFT JOIN web_orders o ON o.account_id = a.id
  GROUP BY r.id, r.name
),
max_sales AS (
  SELECT region_id, MAX(total_sales) AS max_total_sales
  FROM rep_sales
  GROUP BY region_id
)
SELECT
  rt.region_name,
  rt.total_orders,
  rt.region_total_sales,
  rs.rep_name,
  rs.total_sales
FROM region_totals rt
JOIN max_sales ms ON ms.region_id = rt.region_id
JOIN rep_sales rs ON rs.region_id = rt.region_id AND rs.total_sales = ms.max_total_sales
ORDER BY rt.region_name, rs.rep_name;

WITH rep_sales AS (
  SELECT
    r.region_id AS region_id,
    s.id AS rep_id,
    s.name AS rep_name,
    SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS rep_total
  FROM web_orders o
  JOIN web_accounts a ON a.id = o.account_id
  JOIN web_sales_reps s ON s.id = a.sales_rep_id
  JOIN web_region r ON r.id = s.region_id
  GROUP BY r.region_id, s.id, s.name
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT
    s.region_id AS region_id,
    COUNT(o.id) AS num_orders,
    SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS total_sales
  FROM web_orders o
  JOIN web_accounts a ON a.id = o.account_id
  JOIN web_sales_reps s ON s.id = a.sales_rep_id
  GROUP BY s.region_id
),
region_max AS (
  SELECT region_id, MAX(rep_total) AS max_total
  FROM rep_sales
  GROUP BY region_id
)
SELECT
  r.name AS region_name,
  rt.num_orders,
  rt.total_sales,
  rs.rep_name,
  rs.rep_total
FROM region_totals rt
JOIN web_region r ON r.id = rt.region_id
JOIN region_max rm ON rm.region_id = rt.region_id
JOIN rep_sales rs ON rs.region_id = rt.region_id AND rs.rep_total = rm.max_total
ORDER BY r.name, rs.rep_name;

WITH rep_sales AS (
  SELECT
    r.region_id,
    s.id AS rep_id,

    SELECT a.id FROM web_accounts a WHERE a.sales_rep_id = s.id
  )
  JOIN web_region r ON r.id = s.region_id
  GROUP BY r.region_id, s.id, s.name
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.id AS region_id,
    r.name AS region_name,
    COUNT(o.id) AS num_orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amt_usd), 0) AS total_sales
  FROM web_region r
  LEFT JOIN web_sales_reps s ON s.region_id = r.id
  LEFT JOIN web_accounts a ON a.sales_rep_id = s.id
  LEFT JOIN web_orders o ON o.account_id = a.id
  GROUP BY r.id, r.name
),
max_rep AS (
  SELECT region_id, MAX(rep_total) AS max_total
  FROM rep_sales
  GROUP BY region_id
)
SELECT
  rt.region_name,
  rt.num_orders,
  rt.total_sales,
  rs.rep_name,
  rs.rep_total
FROM region_totals rt
LEFT JOIN max_rep mr ON mr.region_id = rt.region_id
LEFT JOIN rep_sales rs ON rs.region_id = rt.region_id AND rs.rep_total = mr.max_total
ORDER BY rt.region_name, rs.rep_total DESC;

WITH english_completed AS (
    SELECT s.StudentID,
           s.StudLastName,
           ss.Grade
    FROM Students s
    JOIN Student_Schedules ss ON ss.StudentID = s.StudentID
    JOIN Classes c ON c.ClassID = ss.ClassID
    JOIN Subjects sub ON sub.SubjectID = c.SubjectID
    WHERE ss.ClassStatus = 2
      AND sub.SubjectName LIKE '%English%'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT ec.StudLastName,
           ec.Grade,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM english_completed e2 WHERE e2.Grade >= ec.Grade) AS rank_count,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM english_completed) AS total_count
    FROM english_completed ec
)
SELECT StudLastName,
       Grade,
       CASE
           WHEN (rank_count * 1.0 / total_count) <= 0.2 THEN 'First'
           WHEN (rank_count * 1.0 / total_count) <= 0.4 THEN 'Second'
           WHEN (rank_count * 1.0 / total_count) <= 0.6 THEN 'Third'
           WHEN (rank_count * 1.0 / total_count) <= 0.8 THEN 'Fourth'
           ELSE 'Fifth'
       END AS Quintile
FROM ranked
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN (rank_count * 1.0 / total_count) <= 0.2 THEN 1
        WHEN (rank_count * 1.0 / total_count) <= 0.4 THEN 2
        WHEN (rank_count * 1.0 / total_count) <= 0.6 THEN 3
        WHEN (rank_count * 1.0 / total_count) <= 0.8 THEN 4
        ELSE 5
    END,
    Grade DESC;

WITH english_completions AS (
    SELECT
        s.StudentID,
        s.StudLastName,
        ss.Grade
    FROM Students s
    JOIN Student_Schedules ss ON ss.StudentID = s.StudentID
    JOIN Classes c ON c.ClassID = ss.ClassID
    JOIN Subjects sub ON sub.SubjectID = c.SubjectID
    JOIN Categories cat ON cat.CategoryID = sub.CategoryID
    WHERE ss.ClassStatus = 2
      AND (LOWER(cat.CategoryDescription) LIKE '%english%'
           OR LOWER(sub.SubjectName) LIKE '%english%')
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ec.StudentID,
        ec.StudLastName,
        ec.Grade,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM english_completions e2 WHERE e2.Grade >= ec.Grade) AS rank_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM english_completions) AS total_count
    FROM english_completions ec
),
quintiles AS (
    SELECT
        StudentID,
        StudLastName,
        Grade,
        CASE
            WHEN (rank_count * 1.0 / total_count) <= 0.2 THEN 'First'
            WHEN (rank_count * 1.0 / total_count) <= 0.4 THEN 'Second'
            WHEN (rank_count * 1.0 / total_count) <= 0.6 THEN 'Third'
            WHEN (rank_count * 1.0 / total_count) <= 0.8 THEN 'Fourth'
            ELSE 'Fifth'
        END AS Quintile
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT StudLastName, Quintile
FROM quintiles
ORDER BY
    CASE Quintile
        WHEN 'First' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Second' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Third' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Fourth' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Fifth' THEN 5
    END,
    Grade DESC;

SELECT s.StudLastName,
       CASE
           WHEN COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Student_Schedules ss2
                                   JOIN Classes c2 ON ss2.ClassID = c2.ClassID
                                   JOIN Subjects sub2 ON c2.SubjectID = sub2.SubjectID
                                   JOIN Categories cat2 ON sub2.CategoryID = cat2.CategoryID
                                   WHERE ss2.ClassStatus = 2
                                     AND cat2.CategoryDescription = 'English') <= 0.2 THEN 'First'
           WHEN COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Student_Schedules ss2
                                   JOIN Classes c2 ON ss2.ClassID = c2.ClassID
                                   JOIN Subjects sub2 ON c2.SubjectID = sub2.SubjectID
                                   JOIN Categories cat2 ON sub2.CategoryID = cat2.CategoryID
                                   WHERE ss2.ClassStatus = 2
                                     AND cat2.CategoryDescription = 'English') <= 0.4 THEN 'Second'
           WHEN COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Student_Schedules ss2
                                   JOIN Classes c2 ON ss2.ClassID = c2.ClassID
                                   JOIN Subjects sub2 ON c2.SubjectID = sub2.SubjectID
                                   JOIN Categories cat2 ON sub2.CategoryID = cat2.CategoryID
                                   WHERE ss2.ClassStatus = 2
                                     AND cat2.CategoryDescription = 'English') <= 0.6 THEN 'Third'
           WHEN COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Student_Schedules ss2
                                   JOIN Classes c2 ON ss2.ClassID = c2.ClassID
                                   JOIN Subjects sub2 ON c2.SubjectID = sub2.SubjectID
                                   JOIN Categories cat2 ON sub2.CategoryID = cat2.CategoryID
                                   WHERE ss2.ClassStatus = 2
                                     AND cat2.CategoryDescription = 'English') <= 0.8 THEN 'Fourth'
           ELSE 'Fifth'
       END AS Quintile
FROM Students s
JOIN Student_Schedules ss ON s.StudentID = ss.StudentID
JOIN Classes c ON ss.ClassID = c.ClassID
JOIN Subjects sub ON c.SubjectID = sub.SubjectID
JOIN Categories cat ON sub.CategoryID = cat.CategoryID
WHERE ss.ClassStatus = 2
  AND cat.CategoryDescription = 'English'
GROUP BY s.StudentID, s.StudLastName, ss.Grade
ORDER BY Quintile;

WITH style_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        ms.StyleID,
        ms.StyleName,
        SUM(CASE 
                WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN 3
                WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN 2
                WHEN mp.PreferenceSeq = 3 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END) AS TotalWeightedScore
    FROM Musical_Styles ms
    JOIN Musical_Preferences mp ON ms.StyleID = mp.StyleID
    GROUP BY ms.StyleID, ms.StyleName
),
avg_score AS (
    SELECT AVG(TotalWeightedScore) AS AvgScore
    FROM style_scores
)
SELECT 
    ss.StyleID,
    ss.StyleName,
    ss.TotalWeightedScore,
    ABS(ss.TotalWeightedScore - a.AvgScore) AS AbsDifference
FROM style_scores ss
CROSS JOIN avg_score a;

WITH style_scores AS (
    SELECT
        ms.StyleID,
        ms.StyleName,
        SUM(
            CASE mp.PreferenceSeq
                WHEN 1 THEN 3
                WHEN 2 THEN 2
                WHEN 3 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS TotalWeightedScore
    FROM Musical_Styles ms
    JOIN Musical_Preferences mp ON ms.StyleID = mp.StyleID
    WHERE mp.PreferenceSeq IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY ms.StyleID, ms.StyleName
),
avg_score AS (
    SELECT AVG(TotalWeightedScore) AS AvgScore
    FROM style_scores
)
SELECT
    ss.StyleID,
    ss.StyleName,
    ss.TotalWeightedScore,
    ABS(ss.TotalWeightedScore - a.AvgScore) AS AbsDifference
FROM style_scores ss
CROSS JOIN avg_score a;

SELECT
  ms.StyleID,
  ms.StyleName,
  SUM(
    CASE mp.PreferenceSeq
      WHEN 1 THEN 3
      WHEN 2 THEN 2
      WHEN 3 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS TotalWeightedScore,
  ABS(
    SUM(
      CASE mp.PreferenceSeq
        WHEN 1 THEN 3
        WHEN 2 THEN 2
        WHEN 3 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) - (
      SELECT AVG(StyleScore)
      FROM (
        SELECT
          SUM(
            CASE mp2.PreferenceSeq
              WHEN 1 THEN 3
              WHEN 2 THEN 2
              WHEN 3 THEN 1
              ELSE 0
            END
          ) AS StyleScore
        FROM Musical_Preferences mp2
        GROUP BY mp2.StyleID
      )
    )
  ) AS AbsDifferenceFromAverage
FROM Musical_Styles ms
JOIN Musical_Preferences mp
  ON mp.StyleID = ms.StyleID
GROUP BY ms.StyleID, ms.StyleName
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

SELECT e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName
FROM Entertainers e
JOIN Entertainer_Styles es1 ON e.EntertainerID = es1.EntertainerID
JOIN Entertainer_Styles es2 ON e.EntertainerID = es2.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers c ON 1=1
JOIN Musical_Preferences mp1 ON c.CustomerID = mp1.CustomerID
JOIN Musical_Preferences mp2 ON c.CustomerID = mp2.CustomerID
WHERE es1.StyleID = mp1.StyleID
  AND es2.StyleID = mp2.StyleID
  AND es1.StyleID <> es2.StyleID
  AND mp1.StyleID <> mp2.StyleID
  AND (
      (es1.StyleStrength = 1 AND es2.StyleStrength = 2 AND mp1.PreferenceSeq = 1 AND mp2.PreferenceSeq = 2)
      OR
      (es1.StyleStrength = 2 AND es2.StyleStrength = 1 AND mp1.PreferenceSeq = 1 AND mp2.PreferenceSeq = 2)
  )
GROUP BY e.EntertainerID, c.CustomerID
HAVING (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Entertainer_Styles es WHERE es.EntertainerID = e.EntertainerID) <= 3
   AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Musical_Preferences mp WHERE mp.CustomerID = c.CustomerID) <= 3;
