WITH pre_agg AS (
  SELECT 'region' AS attr_type, region AS attr_value,
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END) AS pre_sales,
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' THEN sales END) AS post_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date >= date('2020-06-15', '-84 days')
    AND week_date < date('2020-06-15', '+84 days')
  GROUP BY region
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'platform', platform,
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END),
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' THEN sales END)
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date >= date('2020-06-15', '-84 days')
    AND week_date < date('2020-06-15', '+84 days')
  GROUP BY platform
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'age_band', age_band,
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END),
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' THEN sales END)
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date >= date('2020-06-15', '-84 days')
    AND week_date < date('2020-06-15', '+84 days')
  GROUP BY age_band
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'demographic', demographic,
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END),
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' THEN sales END)
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date >= date('2020-06-15', '-84 days')
    AND week_date < date('2020-06-15', '+84 days')
  GROUP BY demographic
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'customer_type', customer_type,
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END),
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' THEN sales END)
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date >= date('2020-06-15', '-84 days')
    AND week_date < date('2020-06-15', '+84 days')
  GROUP BY customer_type
),
changes AS (
  SELECT attr_type, attr_value,
         (post_sales - pre_sales) * 100.0 / pre_sales AS pct_change
  FROM pre_agg
  WHERE pre_sales > 0
)
SELECT attr_type, AVG(pct_change) AS avg_pct_change
FROM changes
GROUP BY attr_type
ORDER BY avg_pct_change ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH before_sales AS (
  SELECT region AS attr_value, 'region' AS attr_type, SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date_formatted >= date('2020-06-15', '-84 days')
    AND week_date_formatted < '2020-06-15'
  GROUP BY region
  UNION ALL
  SELECT platform, 'platform', SUM(sales)
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date_formatted >= date('2020-06-15', '-84 days')
    AND week_date_formatted < '2020-06-15'
  GROUP BY platform
  UNION ALL
  SELECT age_band, 'age_band', SUM(sales)
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date_formatted >= date('2020-06-15', '-84 days')
    AND week_date_formatted < '2020-06-15'
  GROUP BY age_band
  UNION ALL
  SELECT demographic, 'demographic', SUM(sales)
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date_formatted >= date('2020-06-15', '-84 days')
    AND week_date_formatted < '2020-06-15'
  GROUP BY demographic
  UNION ALL
  SELECT customer_type, 'customer_type', SUM(sales)
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date_formatted >= date('2020-06-15', '-84 days')
    AND week_date_formatted < '2020-06-15'
  GROUP BY customer_type
),
after_sales AS (
  SELECT region AS attr_value, 'region' AS attr_type, SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date_formatted >= '2020-06-15'
    AND week_date_formatted < date('2020-06-15', '+84 days')
  GROUP BY region
  UNION ALL
  SELECT platform, 'platform', SUM(sales)
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date_formatted >= '2020-06-15'
    AND week_date_formatted < date('2020-06-15', '+84 days')
  GROUP BY platform
  UNION ALL
  SELECT age_band, 'age_band', SUM(sales)
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date_formatted >= '2020-06-15'
    AND week_date_formatted < date('2020-06-15', '+84 days')
  GROUP BY age_band
  UNION ALL
  SELECT demographic, 'demographic', SUM(sales)
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date_formatted >= '2020-06-15'
    AND week_date_formatted < date('2020-06-15', '+84 days')
  GROUP BY demographic
  UNION ALL
  SELECT customer_type, 'customer_type', SUM(sales)
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date_formatted >= '2020-06-15'
    AND week_date_formatted < date('2020-06-15', '+84 days')
  GROUP BY customer_type
),
changes AS (
  SELECT b.attr_type,
         b.attr_value,
         (a.total_sales - b.total_sales) * 100.0 / b.total_sales AS pct_change
  FROM before_sales b
  JOIN after_sales a
    ON b.attr_type = a.attr_type AND b.attr_value = a.attr_value
  WHERE b.total_sales > 0
)
SELECT attr_type, AVG(pct_change) AS avg_pct_change
FROM changes
GROUP BY attr_type
ORDER BY avg_pct_change ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH pre_agg AS (
  SELECT 'region' AS attr_type, region AS attr_value,
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date_formatted < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END) AS sales_before,
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date_formatted >= '2020-06-15' THEN sales END) AS sales_after
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date_formatted >= date('2020-06-15','-84 days')
    AND week_date_formatted < date('2020-06-15','+84 days')
  GROUP BY region
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'platform', platform,
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date_formatted < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END),
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date_formatted >= '2020-06-15' THEN sales END)
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date_formatted >= date('2020-06-15','-84 days')
    AND week_date_formatted < date('2020-06-15','+84 days')
  GROUP BY platform
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'age_band', age_band,
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date_formatted < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END),
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date_formatted >= '2020-06-15' THEN sales END)
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date_formatted >= date('2020-06-15','-84 days')
    AND week_date_formatted < date('2020-06-15','+84 days')
  GROUP BY age_band
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'demographic', demographic,
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date_formatted < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END),
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date_formatted >= '2020-06-15' THEN sales END)
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date_formatted >= date('2020-06-15','-84 days')
    AND week_date_formatted < date('2020-06-15','+84 days')
  GROUP BY demographic
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'customer_type', customer_type,
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date_formatted < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END),
         SUM(CASE WHEN week_date_formatted >= '2020-06-15' THEN sales END)
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date_formatted >= date('2020-06-15','-84 days')
    AND week_date_formatted < date('2020-06-15','+84 days')
  GROUP BY customer_type
),
changes AS (
  SELECT attr_type, attr_value,
         (sales_after - sales_before) * 100.0 / sales_before AS pct_change
  FROM pre_agg
  WHERE sales_before > 0 AND sales_after IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT attr_type, AVG(pct_change) AS avg_pct_change
FROM changes
GROUP BY attr_type
ORDER BY avg_pct_change ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session) FROM (SELECT session, MIN(CASE WHEN path = '/regist/input' THEN stamp END) AS input_time, MIN(CASE WHEN path = '/regist/confirm' THEN stamp END) AS confirm_time FROM activity_log GROUP BY session) WHERE input_time IS NOT NULL AND confirm_time IS NOT NULL AND input_time < confirm_time;

WITH session_pages AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    path,
    stamp,
    MIN(stamp) OVER (PARTITION BY session) AS first_stamp,
    MAX(stamp) OVER (PARTITION BY session) AS last_stamp
  FROM activity_log
  WHERE path IS NOT NULL
),
landing_exit AS (
  SELECT session, path
  FROM session_pages
  WHERE stamp = first_stamp OR stamp = last_stamp
)
SELECT path, COUNT(DISTINCT session) AS session_count
FROM landing_exit
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY path;

WITH session_paths AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    path,
    stamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp ASC) AS rn_first,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp DESC) AS rn_last
  FROM activity_log
  WHERE path IS NOT NULL
),
landing_exit AS (
  SELECT session, path FROM session_paths WHERE rn_first = 1
  UNION
  SELECT session, path FROM session_paths WHERE rn_last = 1
)
SELECT
  path,
  COUNT(DISTINCT session) AS session_count
FROM landing_exit
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY path;

WITH first_last AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    path,
    MIN(stamp) AS first_stamp,
    MAX(stamp) AS last_stamp
  FROM activity_log
  GROUP BY session, path
),
landing AS (
  SELECT session, path
  FROM activity_log a
  WHERE a.stamp = (
    SELECT MIN(stamp) FROM activity_log b WHERE b.session = a.session
  )
),
exit_pages AS (
  SELECT session, path
  FROM activity_log a
  WHERE a.stamp = (
    SELECT MAX(stamp) FROM activity_log b WHERE b.session = a.session
  )
),
combined AS (
  SELECT session, path FROM landing
  UNION
  SELECT session, path FROM exit_pages
)
SELECT path, COUNT(DISTINCT session) AS session_count
FROM combined
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY path;

SELECT third_page, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM (
    SELECT
        session,
        stamp,
        action AS third_page,
        LAG(action, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS prev1,
        LAG(action, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS prev2
    FROM access_log
)
WHERE prev1 = '/detail' AND prev2 = '/detail'
GROUP BY third_page
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT next_action, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM (
  SELECT
    session,
    action AS next_action,
    LAG(action, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS prev_action,
    LAG(action, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS prev2_action
  FROM read_log
)
WHERE prev_action = '/detail'
  AND prev2_action = '/detail'
GROUP BY next_action
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT next_url, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM (
    SELECT session,
           stamp,
           url AS next_url,
           LAG(url, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS prev_url,
           LAG(url, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS prev2_url
    FROM read_log
)
WHERE prev_url = '/detail'
  AND prev2_url = '/detail'
GROUP BY next_url
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN CAST((CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER)) / 10 AS INTEGER) * 10 = 20 THEN '20s'
    WHEN CAST((CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER)) / 10 AS INTEGER) * 10 = 30 THEN '30s'
    WHEN CAST((CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER)) / 10 AS INTEGER) * 10 = 40 THEN '40s'
    WHEN CAST((CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER)) / 10 AS INTEGER) * 10 = 50 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END AS age_category,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM mst_users
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END AS age_category,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    CAST((julianday('2017-01-01') - julianday(birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
  FROM mst_users
) AS t
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END AS age_category,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER) AS age
  FROM mst_users
  WHERE birth_date IS NOT NULL
) AS t
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category;

WITH first_click AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_stamp
    FROM activity_log
    WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/complete')
    GROUP BY session
),
pre_events AS (
    SELECT
        a.session,
        a.path,
        a.search_type,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.session) AS cnt
    FROM activity_log a
    LEFT JOIN first_click f
        ON a.session = f.session
    WHERE a.search_type IS NOT NULL
      AND a.search_type <> ''
      AND (f.first_stamp IS NULL OR a.stamp < f.first_stamp)
),
session_counts AS (
    SELECT session, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM activity_log a
    LEFT JOIN first_click f
        ON a.session = f.session
    WHERE a.search_type IS NOT NULL
      AND a.search_type <> ''
      AND (f.first_stamp IS NULL OR a.stamp < f.first_stamp)
    GROUP BY a.session
),
min_cnt AS (
    SELECT MIN(cnt) AS m FROM session_counts
)
SELECT a.session, a.path, a.search_type
FROM activity_log a
JOIN session_counts sc ON a.session = sc.session
JOIN min_cnt mc ON sc.cnt = mc.m
LEFT JOIN first_click f ON a.session = f.session
WHERE a.search_type IS NOT NULL
  AND a.search_type <> ''
  AND (f.first_stamp IS NULL OR a.stamp < f.first_stamp);

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    path,
    search_type,
    stamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY session
      ORDER BY stamp
    ) AS rn
  FROM activity_log
),
first_click AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    MIN(CASE WHEN path IN ('/detail', '/complete') THEN rn END) AS first_rn
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY session
),
pre_events AS (
  SELECT
    r.session,
    r.path,
    r.search_type,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.session) AS cnt
  FROM ranked r
  JOIN first_click f
    ON r.session = f.session
  WHERE f.first_rn IS NOT NULL
    AND r.rn < f.first_rn
    AND r.search_type IS NOT NULL
    AND r.search_type <> ''
),
session_counts AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    MAX(cnt) AS cnt
  FROM pre_events
  GROUP BY session
),
min_cnt AS (
  SELECT MIN(cnt) AS min_cnt FROM session_counts
)
SELECT
  p.session,
  p.path,
  p.search_type
FROM pre_events p
JOIN session_counts sc
  ON p.session = sc.session
JOIN min_cnt m
  ON sc.cnt = m.min_cnt
ORDER BY p.session, p.path, p.search_type;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    path,
    search_type,
    stamp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS rn,
    MIN(CASE WHEN path IN ('/detail','/complete') THEN rn END) OVER (PARTITION BY session) AS first_conv_rn
  FROM activity_log
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM ranked
  WHERE search_type IS NOT NULL AND search_type <> ''
    AND (first_conv_rn IS NULL OR rn < first_conv_rn)
  GROUP BY session
),
min_cnt AS (
  SELECT MIN(cnt) AS m FROM counts
)
SELECT r.session, r.path, r.search_type
FROM ranked r
JOIN counts c ON c.session = r.session
JOIN min_cnt m ON c.cnt = m.m
WHERE r.search_type IS NOT NULL AND r.search_type <> ''
  AND (r.first_conv_rn IS NULL OR r.rn < r.first_conv_rn)
ORDER BY r.session, r.rn;

WITH pit_races AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT race_id FROM pit_stops
),
lap_pos AS (
  SELECT lp.race_id, lp.driver_id, lp.lap, lp.position
  FROM lap_positions lp
  JOIN pit_races pr ON pr.race_id = lp.race_id
),
overtakes AS (
  SELECT
    cur.race_id,
    cur.driver_id AS overtaking_driver,
    cur.lap,
    cur.position AS cur_pos,
    prev.position AS prev_pos,
    prev.driver_id AS overtaken_driver
  FROM lap_pos cur
  JOIN lap_pos prev
    ON prev.race_id = cur.race_id
   AND prev.lap = cur.lap - 1
   AND prev.position = cur.position + 1
  WHERE cur.position < prev.position
    AND prev.driver_id <> cur.driver_id
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    r.year,
    -- retirement: overtaken driver retired on same lap
    CASE WHEN ret.driver_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_retirement,
    -- pit entry: overtaken driver pitted on same lap
    CASE WHEN ps_same.driver_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_pit_entry,
    -- pit exit: overtaken driver pitted on previous lap
    CASE WHEN ps_prev.driver_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_pit_exit,
    -- start: lap 1 and within 2 grid positions
    CASE WHEN o.lap = 1
          AND res_cur.grid IS NOT NULL
          AND res_prev.grid IS NOT NULL
          AND ABS(res_cur.grid - res_prev.grid) <= 2
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_start
  FROM overtakes o
  JOIN races r ON r.race_id = o.race_id
  LEFT JOIN retirements ret
    ON ret.race_id = o.race_id
   AND ret.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver
   AND ret.lap = o.lap
  LEFT JOIN pit_stops ps_same
    ON ps_same.race_id = o.race_id
   AND ps_same.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver
   AND ps_same.lap = o.lap
  LEFT JOIN pit_stops ps_prev
    ON ps_prev.race_id = o.race_id
   AND ps_prev.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver
   AND ps_prev.lap = o.lap - 1
  LEFT JOIN results res_cur
    ON res_cur.race_id = o.race_id
   AND res_cur.driver_id = o.overtaking_driver
  LEFT JOIN results res_prev
    ON res_prev.race_id = o.race_id
   AND res_prev.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN is_retirement = 1 THEN 'R'
      WHEN is_pit_entry = 1 OR is_pit_exit = 1 THEN 'P'
      WHEN is_start = 1 THEN 'S'
      ELSE 'T'
    END AS label
  FROM classified
)
SELECT label, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM labeled
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY label;

WITH lap_data AS (
  SELECT
    lp.race_id,
    lp.driver_id,
    lp.lap,
    lp.position,
    LAG(lp.position) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS prev_position
  FROM lap_positions lp
  JOIN races_ext re ON re.race_id = lp.race_id
  WHERE re.is_pit_data_available = 1
),
overtakes AS (
  SELECT
    cur.race_id,
    cur.lap,
    cur.driver_id AS overtaking_driver,
    prev.driver_id AS overtaken_driver,
    cur.position AS cur_pos,
    prev.position AS prev_pos
  FROM lap_data cur
  JOIN lap_data prev
    ON prev.race_id = cur.race_id
   AND prev.lap = cur.lap
   AND prev.position = cur.position + 1
  WHERE cur.prev_position IS NOT NULL
    AND cur.prev_position > cur.position
    AND prev.prev_position IS NOT NULL
    AND prev.prev_position < prev.position
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    o.race_id,
    o.lap,
    o.overtaking_driver,
    o.overtaken_driver,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM retirements r
        WHERE r.race_id = o.race_id
          AND r.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver
          AND r.lap = o.lap
      ) THEN 'R'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pit_stops ps
        WHERE ps.race_id = o.race_id
          AND ps.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver
          AND ps.lap = o.lap
      ) THEN 'P'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pit_stops ps
        WHERE ps.race_id = o.race_id
          AND ps.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver
          AND ps.lap = o.lap - 1
      ) THEN 'P'
      WHEN o.lap = 1 AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM results r1
        JOIN results r2 ON r1.race_id = r2.race_id
        WHERE r1.race_id = o.race_id
          AND r1.driver_id = o.overtaking_driver
          AND r2.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver
          AND ABS(r1.grid - r2.grid) <= 2
      ) THEN 'S'
      ELSE 'T'
    END AS overtake_type
  FROM overtakes o
)
SELECT
  overtake_type,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM classified
GROUP BY overtake_type
ORDER BY overtake_type;

WITH lap_data AS (
  SELECT
    lp.race_id,
    lp.driver_id,
    lp.lap,
    lp.position AS curr_pos,
    LAG(lp.position) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS prev_pos,
    LAG(lp.lap) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS prev_lap
  FROM lap_positions lp
  JOIN races_ext re ON re.race_id = lp.race_id
  WHERE re.is_pit_data_available = 1
),
overtakes AS (
  SELECT
    a.race_id,
    a.lap,
    a.driver_id AS overtaker_id,
    b.driver_id AS overtaken_id,
    a.prev_pos AS overtaker_prev_pos,
    a.curr_pos AS overtaker_curr_pos,
    b.prev_pos AS overtaken_prev_pos,
    b.curr_pos AS overtaken_curr_pos
  FROM lap_data a
  JOIN lap_data b
    ON b.race_id = a.race_id
   AND b.lap = a.lap
   AND b.driver_id <> a.driver_id
  WHERE a.prev_lap = a.lap - 1
    AND b.prev_lap = b.lap - 1
    AND a.prev_pos > b.prev_pos
    AND a.curr_pos < b.curr_pos
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    r.year,
    -- retirement
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM retirements rt
      WHERE rt.race_id = o.race_id
        AND rt.driver_id = o.overtaken_id
        AND rt.lap = o.lap
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_retirement,
    -- pit entry by overtaken driver on this lap
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM pit_stops ps
      WHERE ps.race_id = o.race_id
        AND ps.driver_id = o.overtaken_id
        AND ps.lap = o.lap
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_pit_entry,
    -- pit exit by overtaken driver (pitted previous lap)
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM pit_stops ps
      WHERE ps.race_id = o.race_id
        AND ps.driver_id = o.overtaken_id
        AND ps.lap = o.lap - 1
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_pit_exit,
    -- start: lap 1 and within 2 grid positions
    CASE WHEN o.lap = 1 AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM results r1
      JOIN results r2 ON r1.race_id = r2.race_id
      WHERE r1.race_id = o.race_id
        AND r1.driver_id = o.overtaker_id
        AND r2.driver_id = o.overtaken_id
        AND ABS(r1.grid - r2.grid) <= 2
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_start
  FROM overtakes o
  JOIN races r ON r.race_id = o.race_id
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN is_retirement = 1 THEN 'R'
    WHEN is_pit_entry = 1 OR is_pit_exit = 1 THEN 'P'
    WHEN is_start = 1 THEN 'S'
    ELSE 'T'
  END AS overtake_type,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM classified
GROUP BY overtake_type
ORDER BY overtake_type;

WITH lap_positions_first5 AS (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position
  FROM lap_positions
  WHERE lap <= 5
),
overtakes AS (
  SELECT
    lp1.race_id,
    lp1.driver_id AS overtaking_driver_id,
    lp2.driver_id AS overtaken_driver_id,
    lp1.lap,
    lp1.position AS new_position,
    lp2.position AS old_position
  FROM lap_positions_first5 lp1
  JOIN lap_positions_first5 lp2
    ON lp1.race_id = lp2.race_id
   AND lp1.lap = lp2.lap
   AND lp1.position < lp2.position
  JOIN lap_positions_first5 prev1
    ON prev1.race_id = lp1.race_id
   AND prev1.driver_id = lp1.driver_id
   AND prev1.lap = lp1.lap - 1
  JOIN lap_positions_first5 prev2
    ON prev2.race_id = lp2.race_id
   AND prev2.driver_id = lp2.driver_id
   AND prev2.lap = lp2.lap - 1
  WHERE prev1.position > prev2.position
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    o.race_id,
    o.overtaking_driver_id,
    o.overtaken_driver_id,
    o.lap,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM retirements r
        WHERE r.race_id = o.race_id
          AND r.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver_id
          AND r.lap = o.lap
      ) THEN 'R'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pit_stops ps
        WHERE ps.race_id = o.race_id
          AND ps.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver_id
          AND ps.lap = o.lap
      ) THEN 'P'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pit_stops ps
        WHERE ps.race_id = o.race_id
          AND ps.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver_id
          AND ps.lap = o.lap - 1
      ) THEN 'P'
      WHEN o.lap = 1 AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM results res1
        JOIN results res2 ON res1.race_id = res2.race_id
        WHERE res1.race_id = o.race_id
          AND res1.driver_id = o.overtaking_driver_id
          AND res2.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver_id
          AND ABS(res1.grid - res2.grid) <= 2
      ) THEN 'S'
      ELSE 'T'
    END AS category
  FROM overtakes o
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retirements,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pit_stops,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS start_overtakes,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS track_overtakes
FROM classified;

WITH lap_positions_ordered AS (
  SELECT
    race_id,
    driver_id,
    lap,
    position,
    LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_position,
    LAG(lap) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_lap
  FROM lap_positions
),
overtakes AS (
  SELECT
    lp.race_id,
    lp.driver_id AS overtaking_driver_id,
    lp.lap,
    lp.position AS new_position,
    lp.prev_position AS old_position
  FROM lap_positions_ordered lp
  WHERE lp.prev_position IS NOT NULL
    AND lp.position < lp.prev_position
    AND lp.lap <= 5
),
overtaken AS (
  SELECT
    o.race_id,
    o.overtaking_driver_id,
    o.lap,
    o.new_position,
    o.old_position,
    (
      SELECT lp2.driver_id
      FROM lap_positions lp2
      WHERE lp2.race_id = o.race_id
        AND lp2.lap = o.lap
        AND lp2.position = o.new_position + 1
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS overtaken_driver_id
  FROM overtakes o
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    ov.race_id,
    ov.overtaking_driver_id,
    ov.overtaken_driver_id,
    ov.lap,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM retirements r
        WHERE r.race_id = ov.race_id
          AND r.driver_id = ov.overtaken_driver_id
          AND r.lap = ov.lap
      ) THEN 'R'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pit_stops ps
        WHERE ps.race_id = ov.race_id
          AND ps.driver_id = ov.overtaken_driver_id
          AND ps.lap = ov.lap
      ) THEN 'P'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pit_stops ps
        WHERE ps.race_id = ov.race_id
          AND ps.driver_id = ov.overtaken_driver_id
          AND ps.lap = ov.lap - 1
      ) THEN 'P'
      WHEN ov.lap = 1
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM results r1
          JOIN results r2
            ON r1.race_id = r2.race_id
          WHERE r1.race_id = ov.race_id
            AND r1.driver_id = ov.overtaking_driver_id
            AND r2.driver_id = ov.overtaken_driver_id
            AND ABS(r1.grid - r2.grid) <= 2
        ) THEN 'S'
      ELSE 'T'
    END AS category
  FROM overtaken ov
  WHERE ov.overtaken_driver_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retirements,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pit_stops,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS start_overtakes,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS track_overtakes
FROM classified;

WITH lap_pos AS (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position
  FROM lap_positions
  WHERE lap BETWEEN 1 AND 5
),
overtakes AS (
  SELECT
    a.race_id,
    a.lap,
    a.driver_id AS overtaker_id,
    a.position AS new_pos,
    b.driver_id AS overtaken_id,
    b.position AS old_pos
  FROM lap_pos a
  JOIN lap_pos b
    ON a.race_id = b.race_id
   AND a.lap = b.lap
   AND b.position = a.position + 1
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    o.race_id,
    o.lap,
    o.overtaker_id,
    o.overtaken_id,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM retirements r
        WHERE r.race_id = o.race_id
          AND r.driver_id = o.overtaken_id
          AND r.lap = o.lap
      ) THEN 'R'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pit_stops p
        WHERE p.race_id = o.race_id
          AND p.driver_id = o.overtaken_id
          AND p.lap = o.lap
      ) THEN 'P'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM pit_stops p
        WHERE p.race_id = o.race_id
          AND p.driver_id = o.overtaken_id
          AND p.lap = o.lap - 1
      ) THEN 'P'
      WHEN o.lap = 1 AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM results r1
        JOIN results r2
          ON r1.race_id = r2.race_id
        WHERE r1.race_id = o.race_id
          AND r1.driver_id = o.overtaker_id
          AND r2.driver_id = o.overtaken_id
          AND ABS(r1.grid - r2.grid) <= 2
      ) THEN 'S'
      ELSE 'T'
    END AS category
  FROM overtakes o
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retirements,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pit_stops,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS start,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'T' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS track
FROM classified;

SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS season_count
FROM (
  SELECT r.year, res.constructor_id, SUM(res.points) AS total_points
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
  WHERE r.year >= 2001
  GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id
  HAVING SUM(res.points) > 0
) cte
JOIN constructors c ON cte.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE cte.total_points = (
  SELECT MIN(total_points)
  FROM (
    SELECT r2.year, res2.constructor_id, SUM(res2.points) AS total_points
    FROM results res2
    JOIN races r2 ON res2.race_id = r2.race_id
    WHERE r2.year = cte.year AND r2.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r2.year, res2.constructor_id
    HAVING SUM(res2.points) > 0
  )
)
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY season_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS season_count
FROM (
  SELECT r.year, res.constructor_id, SUM(res.points) AS total_points
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
  WHERE r.year >= 2001
  GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id
  HAVING SUM(res.points) > 0
) cte
JOIN (
  SELECT year, MIN(total_points) AS min_points
  FROM (
    SELECT r.year, res.constructor_id, SUM(res.points) AS total_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, res.constructor_id
    HAVING SUM(res.points) > 0
  )
  GROUP BY year
) mins ON cte.year = mins.year AND cte.total_points = mins.min_points
JOIN constructors c ON cte.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY season_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH driver_season_points AS (
  SELECT
    r.year,
    res.driver_id,
    res.constructor_id,
    SUM(res.points) AS total_points
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON r.race_id = res.race_id
  WHERE r.year >= 2001
  GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id, res.constructor_id
),
scoring_drivers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM driver_season_points
  WHERE total_points > 0
),
min_per_season AS (
  SELECT year, MIN(total_points) AS min_points
  FROM scoring_drivers
  GROUP BY year
),
lowest_scorers AS (
  SELECT sd.year, sd.driver_id, sd.constructor_id, sd.total_points
  FROM scoring_drivers sd
  JOIN min_per_season m
    ON m.year = sd.year AND m.min_points = sd.total_points
)
SELECT
  c.name AS constructor_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ls.year) AS season_count
FROM lowest_scorers ls
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id = ls.constructor_id
GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.name
ORDER BY season_count DESC, c.name ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT r.year,
       MAX(driver_points) + MAX(constructor_points) AS total
FROM (
    SELECT ra.year,
           res.driver_id,
           SUM(res.points) AS driver_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races ra ON ra.race_id = res.race_id
    GROUP BY ra.year, res.driver_id
) r
JOIN (
    SELECT ra.year,
           res.constructor_id,
           SUM(res.points) AS constructor_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races ra ON ra.race_id = res.race_id
    GROUP BY ra.year, res.constructor_id
) c ON c.year = r.year
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY total ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT r.year,
       MAX(driver_points) + MAX(constructor_points) AS total
FROM (
    SELECT ra.year,
           res.driver_id,
           SUM(res.points) AS driver_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races ra ON ra.race_id = res.race_id
    GROUP BY ra.year, res.driver_id
) r
JOIN (
    SELECT ra.year,
           res.constructor_id,
           SUM(res.points) AS constructor_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races ra ON ra.race_id = res.race_id
    GROUP BY ra.year, res.constructor_id
) c ON c.year = r.year
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY total ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT r.year,
       MAX(driver_points) + MAX(constructor_points) AS total
FROM (
    SELECT ra.year,
           res.driver_id,
           SUM(res.points) AS driver_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races ra ON ra.race_id = res.race_id
    GROUP BY ra.year, res.driver_id
) r
JOIN (
    SELECT ra.year,
           res.constructor_id,
           SUM(res.points) AS constructor_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races ra ON ra.race_id = res.race_id
    GROUP BY ra.year, res.constructor_id
) c ON c.year = r.year
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY total ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.name, r.year, SUM(ds.points) AS combined_points
FROM driver_standings ds
JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN results res ON res.race_id = r.race_id AND res.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE ds.position = 1
GROUP BY c.constructor_id, r.year
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.name, r.year, SUM(ds.points) AS combined_points
FROM driver_standings ds
JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN results res ON res.race_id = r.race_id AND res.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE ds.position = 1
GROUP BY c.constructor_id, r.year
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.name AS constructor_name, r.year, SUM(ds.points) AS combined_points
FROM driver_standings ds
JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN results res ON res.race_id = r.race_id AND res.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE ds.position = 1
GROUP BY c.constructor_id, r.year
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name
FROM drives dr
JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = dr.driver_id
JOIN races r_first ON r_first.year = dr.year AND r_first.round = dr.first_round
JOIN races r_last ON r_last.year = dr.year AND r_last.round = dr.last_round
WHERE dr.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
  AND dr.constructor_id = dr.constructor_id
  AND dr.first_round <> dr.last_round
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON r.race_id = res.race_id
    WHERE res.driver_id = dr.driver_id
      AND r.year = dr.year
      AND res.constructor_id = dr.constructor_id
    GROUP BY res.driver_id, r.year
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.round) >= 2
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM results res_first
    WHERE res_first.race_id = r_first.race_id
      AND res_first.driver_id = dr.driver_id
      AND res_first.constructor_id = dr.constructor_id
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM results res_last
    WHERE res_last.race_id = r_last.race_id
      AND res_last.driver_id = dr.driver_id
      AND res_last.constructor_id = dr.constructor_id
  );

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, r.year, c.name AS constructor_name
FROM drives dr
JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = dr.driver_id
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id = dr.constructor_id
JOIN races r ON r.year = dr.year
WHERE dr.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
  AND dr.is_first_drive_of_season = 1
  AND dr.is_final_drive_of_season = 1
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM results res
    JOIN races rr ON rr.race_id = res.race_id
    WHERE res.driver_id = dr.driver_id
      AND res.constructor_id = dr.constructor_id
      AND rr.year = dr.year
      AND rr.round = dr.first_round
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM results res
    JOIN races rr ON rr.race_id = res.race_id
    WHERE res.driver_id = dr.driver_id
      AND res.constructor_id = dr.constructor_id
      AND rr.year = dr.year
      AND rr.round = dr.last_round
  )
  AND (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rr.round)
    FROM results res
    JOIN races rr ON rr.race_id = res.race_id
    WHERE res.driver_id = dr.driver_id
      AND rr.year = dr.year
  ) >= 2
ORDER BY r.year, driver_name;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name
FROM (
  SELECT r.year, res.driver_id, res.constructor_id,
         MIN(r.round) AS first_round,
         MAX(r.round) AS last_round,
         COUNT(DISTINCT r.round) AS rounds_count
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
  WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
  GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id, res.constructor_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.round) >= 2
     AND MIN(r.round) = (SELECT MIN(r2.round) FROM results res2 JOIN races r2 ON res2.race_id = r2.race_id WHERE r2.year = r.year AND res2.driver_id = res.driver_id)
     AND MAX(r.round) = (SELECT MAX(r3.round) FROM results res3 JOIN races r3 ON res3.race_id = r3.race_id WHERE r3.year = r.year AND res3.driver_id = res.driver_id)
) AS season_constructor
JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = season_constructor.driver_id
GROUP BY d.driver_id
ORDER BY driver_name;

WITH race_constructor AS (
  SELECT r.race_id, r.year, r.round, res.driver_id, res.constructor_id
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON r.race_id = res.race_id
),
driver_races AS (
  SELECT rc.driver_id, rc.year, rc.round, rc.race_id, rc.constructor_id,
         LEAD(rc.round) OVER (PARTITION BY rc.driver_id, rc.year ORDER BY rc.round) AS next_round,
         LEAD(rc.constructor_id) OVER (PARTITION BY rc.driver_id, rc.year ORDER BY rc.round) AS next_constructor_id
  FROM race_constructor rc
),
missed AS (
  SELECT dr.driver_id, dr.year,
         dr.round + 1 AS first_missed_round,
         dr.next_round - 1 AS last_missed_round,
         dr.next_round - dr.round - 1 AS missed_count,
         dr.constructor_id AS before_constructor_id,
         dr.next_constructor_id AS after_constructor_id
  FROM driver_races dr
  WHERE dr.next_round IS NOT NULL
    AND dr.next_round - dr.round - 1 > 0
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM missed
  WHERE missed_count < 3
    AND before_constructor_id <> after_constructor_id
)
SELECT AVG(first_missed_round) AS avg_first_round,
       AVG(last_missed_round) AS avg_last_round
FROM filtered;

WITH race_drives AS (
  SELECT r.year, r.round, r.race_id, res.driver_id, res.constructor_id
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON r.race_id = res.race_id
),
driver_year_rounds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT year, driver_id FROM race_drives
),
all_rounds AS (
  SELECT year, round, race_id FROM races
),
missed AS (
  SELECT dy.year, dy.driver_id, ar.round AS missed_round, ar.race_id AS missed_race_id
  FROM driver_year_rounds dy
  JOIN all_rounds ar ON ar.year = dy.year
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM race_drives rd
    WHERE rd.year = dy.year AND rd.driver_id = dy.driver_id AND rd.round = ar.round
  )
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT m.year, m.driver_id,
         MIN(m.missed_round) AS first_missed_round,
         MAX(m.missed_round) AS last_missed_round,
         COUNT(*) AS missed_count
  FROM missed m
  GROUP BY m.year, m.driver_id
),
valid_gaps AS (
  SELECT g.*,
    (SELECT rd.constructor_id FROM race_drives rd
     WHERE rd.year = g.year AND rd.driver_id = g.driver_id
       AND rd.round < g.first_missed_round
     ORDER BY rd.round DESC LIMIT 1) AS before_constructor,
    (SELECT rd.constructor_id FROM race_drives rd
     WHERE rd.year = g.year AND rd.driver_id = g.driver_id
       AND rd.round > g.last_missed_round
     ORDER BY rd.round ASC LIMIT 1) AS after_constructor
  FROM gaps g
  WHERE g.missed_count < 3
)
SELECT AVG(first_missed_round) AS avg_first_round,
       AVG(last_missed_round) AS avg_last_round
FROM valid_gaps
WHERE before_constructor IS NOT NULL
  AND after_constructor IS NOT NULL
  AND before_constructor <> after_constructor;

WITH race_constructor AS (
  SELECT r.race_id, r.year, r.round, res.driver_id, res.constructor_id
  FROM races r
  JOIN results res ON res.race_id = r.race_id
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT rc.driver_id, rc.year,
         rc.round AS before_round,
         rc.constructor_id AS before_constructor,
         LEAD(rc.round) OVER (PARTITION BY rc.driver_id, rc.year ORDER BY rc.round) AS after_round,
         LEAD(rc.constructor_id) OVER (PARTITION BY rc.driver_id, rc.year ORDER BY rc.round) AS after_constructor
  FROM race_constructor rc
),
missed AS (
  SELECT g.driver_id, g.year,
         g.after_round - g.before_round - 1 AS missed_count,
         g.before_constructor,
         g.after_constructor
  FROM gaps g
  WHERE g.after_round IS NOT NULL
    AND g.after_round - g.before_round - 1 > 0
    AND g.after_round - g.before_round - 1 < 3
    AND g.before_constructor <> g.after_constructor
)
SELECT AVG(missed_count) AS avg_missed,
       AVG(before_round) AS avg_first_round,
       AVG(after_round) AS avg_last_round
FROM (
  SELECT m.driver_id, m.year, m.missed_count,
         MIN(g.before_round) AS before_round,
         MAX(g.after_round) AS after_round
  FROM missed m
  JOIN gaps g ON g.driver_id = m.driver_id AND g.year = m.year
  GROUP BY m.driver_id, m.year, m.missed_count
);

WITH lap_changes AS (
  SELECT
    lp.race_id,
    lp.driver_id,
    lp.lap,
    lp.position AS pos,
    LAG(lp.position) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS prev_pos
  FROM lap_positions lp
  WHERE lp.lap > 1
),
overtakes AS (
  SELECT
    lc.race_id,
    lc.driver_id,
    lc.lap,
    lc.pos,
    lc.prev_pos,
    CASE WHEN lc.pos < lc.prev_pos THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS gained
  FROM lap_changes lc
  WHERE lc.prev_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND lc.pos <> lc.prev_pos
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM pit_stops ps
      WHERE ps.race_id = lc.race_id
        AND ps.driver_id = lc.driver_id
        AND (ps.lap = lc.lap OR ps.lap = lc.lap - 1)
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM retirements r
      WHERE r.race_id = lc.race_id
        AND r.driver_id = lc.driver_id
        AND r.lap = lc.lap
    )
),
driver_overtakes AS (
  SELECT
    o.driver_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.gained = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overtook_others,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.gained = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_overtaken
  FROM overtakes o
  GROUP BY o.driver_id
)
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM driver_overtakes do
JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = do.driver_id
WHERE do.was_overtaken > do.overtook_others
ORDER BY full_name;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM drivers d
JOIN (
    SELECT driver_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN position_change < 0 THEN -position_change ELSE 0 END) AS overtaken,
           SUM(CASE WHEN position_change > 0 THEN position_change ELSE 0 END) AS overtakes
    FROM (
        SELECT lp.driver_id,
               lp.race_id,
               lp.lap,
               lp.position - LAG(lp.position) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS position_change
        FROM lap_positions lp
        WHERE lp.lap > 1
          AND lp.lap_type = 'race'
    )
    WHERE position_change IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY driver_id
) t ON d.driver_id = t.driver_id
WHERE t.overtaken > t.overtakes;

WITH lap_changes AS (
  SELECT
    lp.race_id,
    lp.driver_id,
    lp.lap,
    lp.position AS pos,
    LAG(lp.position) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS prev_pos,
    LAG(lp.lap) OVER (PARTITION BY lp.race_id, lp.driver_id ORDER BY lp.lap) AS prev_lap
  FROM lap_positions lp
),
overtakes AS (
  SELECT
    lc.race_id,
    lc.driver_id,
    lc.lap,
    lc.pos,
    lc.prev_pos,
    lc.prev_lap
  FROM lap_changes lc
  WHERE lc.prev_pos IS NOT NULL
    AND lc.lap > 1
    AND lc.prev_lap = lc.lap - 1
    AND lc.pos <> lc.prev_pos
),
pit_laps AS (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap AS pit_lap
  FROM pit_stops
),
valid_changes AS (
  SELECT o.*
  FROM overtakes o
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM pit_laps p
    WHERE p.race_id = o.race_id
      AND p.driver_id = o.driver_id
      AND p.pit_lap IN (o.lap, o.lap - 1)
  )
),
gained AS (
  SELECT race_id, lap, driver_id, prev_pos, pos
  FROM valid_changes
  WHERE pos < prev_pos
),
lost AS (
  SELECT race_id, lap, driver_id, prev_pos, pos
  FROM valid_changes
  WHERE pos > prev_pos
),
overtook_counts AS (
  SELECT g.driver_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM gained g
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM lost l
    WHERE l.race_id = g.race_id
      AND l.lap = g.lap
      AND l.prev_pos = g.pos
      AND l.pos = g.prev_pos
  )
  GROUP BY g.driver_id
),
overtaken_counts AS (
  SELECT l.driver_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM lost l
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM gained g
    WHERE g.race_id = l.race_id
      AND g.lap = l.lap
      AND g.prev_pos = l.pos
      AND g.pos = l.prev_pos
  )
  GROUP BY l.driver_id
)
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM drivers d
LEFT JOIN overtook_counts oc ON oc.driver_id = d.driver_id
LEFT JOIN overtaken_counts ot ON ot.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE COALESCE(ot.cnt, 0) > COALESCE(oc.cnt, 0)
ORDER BY full_name;
